principle.en: The average close of the last N bars. It smooths out daily noise so you see the direction; the slope and whether price sits above or below it matter more than the number itself.
principle.zh: 最近 N 根 K 线收盘价的平均值，滤掉日常噪音、看清方向。关键看它的斜率，以及价格在它上方还是下方。

example.en: A stock in an uptrend pulls back to its rising MA20 three times and bounces each time. Each touch is a low-risk spot to buy, with a stop just below the line.
example.zh: 一只上涨股三次回踩上行的 MA20 都弹起，每次回踩都是低风险买点，止损放在均线略下方。

formula.en:
MID = SMA(C, 20)
UPPER = MID + 2σ
LOWER = MID − 2σ
%B = (C − LOWER) / (UPPER − LOWER)
Bandwidth = (UPPER − LOWER) / MID
formula.zh:
中轨 = SMA(C, 20)
上轨 = 中轨 + 2σ
下轨 = 中轨 − 2σ
%B = (C − 下轨) / (上轨 − 下轨)
带宽 = (上轨 − 下轨) / 中轨

principle.en: A moving average with bands two standard deviations above and below. The bands widen when the market is jumpy and squeeze when it is calm, showing how unusual today's price is.
principle.zh: 一条均线加上下两倍标准差的通道。市场躁动时通道张开，平静时收窄，用来衡量当前价格有多「不寻常」。

example.en: Like a coiled spring: when the bands pinch to a six-month low and price then closes outside them on big volume, a strong move has usually just started.
example.zh: 像压紧的弹簧：带宽缩到半年最窄后，价格放量收在通道外，往往意味着一段大行情刚刚开始。

name.zh: 指数平滑异同移动平均线（MACD）

formula.en:
DIF = EMA(C, 12) − EMA(C, 26)
DEA = EMA(DIF, 9)   (signal line)
MACD = (DIF − DEA) × 2   (histogram)
formula.zh:
DIF = EMA(C, 12) − EMA(C, 26)
DEA = EMA(DIF, 9)（信号线）
MACD = (DIF − DEA) × 2（柱状图）

principle.en: The gap between a fast and a slow average measures trend momentum. The histogram shows whether that momentum is speeding up or fading, so it turns before the lines cross.
principle.zh: 快慢两条均线的差距衡量趋势的动量；柱状图显示动量在加速还是衰减，所以它比两线交叉更早转向。

example.en: Price makes three lower lows, but each DIF low is shallower: sellers are tiring. The buy signal is the golden cross that follows this divergence.
example.zh: 价格连创三次新低，但 DIF 的低点一次比一次浅，说明卖盘在衰竭；随后出现的金叉才是买点。

formula.en:
RS = average gain / average loss (N bars)
RSI = 100 − 100 / (1 + RS)
Default N = 14, Wilder smoothing
formula.zh:
RS = 平均涨幅 / 平均跌幅（N 根 K 线）
RSI = 100 − 100 / (1 + RS)
默认 N = 14，威尔德平滑

principle.en: The share of recent price movement that went up, on a 0–100 scale. Above 70 means most of the energy was upward; in a strong trend that is strength, not a sell signal.
principle.zh: 近期涨跌中「上涨」所占的比例，0–100 之间。高于 70 说明大部分力量向上；强趋势里这是强势，而不是卖出信号。

example.en: A stock trading between $40 and $46 dips to $39.5, but RSI is 32 versus 26 at the last low. Less selling pressure: buy when RSI crosses back above 30.
example.zh: 一只在 40–46 美元震荡的股票跌到 39.5，但 RSI 为 32，高于上次低点的 26；卖压减弱，RSI 回到 30 上方时买入。

formula.en:
ADR = stocks up today / stocks down today
ADR > 1 → more advancers
Often smoothed: MA(ADR, 10)
formula.zh:
ADR = 当日上涨家数 / 当日下跌家数
ADR > 1 → 上涨家数更多
常做平滑：MA(ADR, 10)

principle.en: How many index members rose divided by how many fell. It shows whether a rally is broad or carried by a few giant stocks.
principle.zh: 成分股上涨家数除以下跌家数。它告诉你指数上涨是全面开花，还是只靠几只巨头撑着。

example.en: Like a team where one star scores every goal: the index hits new highs while most stocks fall. A shrinking ADR warns the rally's base is eroding.
example.zh: 就像一支球队只靠一个球星得分：指数创新高，多数股票却在跌。涨跌比走低，提示上涨根基正在松动。

principle.en: An average where recent bars count more and older bars fade out smoothly. It reacts faster than a simple average and doesn't jump when an old bar drops out.
principle.zh: 越近的 K 线权重越大，越老的权重平滑衰减。比简单均线反应更快，也不会因为旧数据移出窗口而跳动。

example.en: A stock breaks out at $42 and rises for ten weeks; each dip to the rising EMA20 that closes back above it is a low-risk place to add.
example.zh: 一只股票在 42 美元突破后涨了十周，每次回踩上行的 EMA20 又收回上方，都是低风险加仓点。

principle.en: An average whose weights fall in a straight line: the newest bar counts most, the oldest least. It lags about a third less than a simple average but is a bit jumpier.
principle.zh: 权重线性递减：最新一根最重，最老一根最轻。比简单均线滞后少约三分之一，但更容易抖动。

example.en: After price bases for two hours, three strong bars appear. WMA9 turns up on the second bar; an SMA9 needs two more bars to tilt.
example.zh: 价格横盘两小时后连出三根大阳线，WMA9 在第二根就拐头向上，而 SMA9 还要再等两根。

formula.en:
E1 = EMA(C, n)
E2 = EMA(E1, n)
DEMA = 2·E1 − E2
Default n = 9
formula.zh:
E1 = EMA(C, n)
E2 = EMA(E1, n)
DEMA = 2·E1 − E2
默认 n = 9

principle.en: An EMA with its own lag estimated and added back. The gap between the EMA and an EMA of the EMA approximates the lag, so adding it pulls the line closer to price.
principle.zh: 估算出 EMA 自身的滞后再加回去。EMA 与「EMA 的 EMA」之差约等于滞后量，补回后线更贴近价格。

example.en: An index runs from 3,850 to 4,300. An EMA20 signal fires near 3,995; DEMA(9) fires near 3,915, catching about 80 more points.
example.zh: 某指数从 3850 涨到 4300。EMA20 在 3995 附近才发信号，DEMA(9) 在 3915 附近就发出，多吃约 80 点。

formula.en:
E1 = EMA(C, n), E2 = EMA(E1, n), E3 = EMA(E2, n)
TEMA = 3·E1 − 3·E2 + E3
Default n = 9
formula.zh:
E1 = EMA(C, n)，E2 = EMA(E1, n)，E3 = EMA(E2, n)
TEMA = 3·E1 − 3·E2 + E3
默认 n = 9

principle.en: The DEMA lag-correction trick applied twice, so it keeps up even with an accelerating trend. The price is extra noise and more false turns.
principle.zh: 把 DEMA 的滞后修正再做一次，连加速中的趋势也能跟上。代价是噪音更多、假拐点更多。

example.en: On a 180-pip breakout, TEMA(9) turns up around pip 25, DEMA(9) around pip 38 and EMA(9) around pip 61.
example.zh: 一段 180 点的突破行情中，TEMA(9) 约在第 25 点拐头，DEMA(9) 在第 38 点，EMA(9) 要到第 61 点。

formula.en:
raw = 2·WMA(C, n/2) − WMA(C, n)
HMA = WMA(raw, √n)
Default n = 9
formula.zh:
原始值 = 2·WMA(C, n/2) − WMA(C, n)
HMA = WMA(原始值, √n)
默认 n = 9

principle.en: First a difference of two WMAs removes the lag, then a very short WMA smooths the result again. You get a line that is both fast and clean.
principle.zh: 先用两条 WMA 之差消除滞后，再用一条很短的 WMA 重新平滑，得到一条又快又顺的线。

example.en: Rule: hold only while HMA55 is rising. On a stock going from $28 to $52, you ride the whole move and exit near $50.40, within two bars of the top.
example.zh: 规则：HMA55 向上才持有。一只从 28 涨到 52 美元的股票，你能吃下整段，并在顶部两根 K 线内约 50.4 美元离场。

formula.en:
Fit C_k ≈ a + b·k over the last n bars
LSMA = a + b·(n − 1)
b = slope (price change per bar)
Default n = 25
formula.zh:
对最近 n 根做拟合：C_k ≈ a + b·k
LSMA = a + b·(n − 1)
b = 斜率（每根 K 线的价格变化）
默认 n = 25

principle.en: Not an average: it is today's point on the straight line that best fits the last n closes. In a clean trend it has almost no lag, and the slope tells you the trend's speed.
principle.zh: 它不是平均值，而是最近 n 根收盘价最佳拟合直线在今天的位置。趋势平稳时几乎没有滞后，斜率直接给出趋势速度。

example.en: A stock climbs steadily about $0.28 a day and stays within ±2.5% of the line. Buy touches of the line; exit when the slope flattens.
example.zh: 一只股票每天稳定上涨约 0.28 美元，始终在直线上下 2.5% 内波动。回踩直线就买，斜率走平就卖。

name.zh: 成交量加权移动平均线（VWMA）

formula.en:
VWMA(n) = Σ(C × V) / Σ(V)
Default n = 20
VWMA > SMA → heavy volume at high prices
VWMA < SMA → heavy volume at low prices
formula.zh:
VWMA(n) = Σ(C × V) / Σ(V)
默认 n = 20
VWMA > SMA → 大成交量发生在高价
VWMA < SMA → 大成交量发生在低价

principle.en: The average price at which shares actually traded, weighting each bar by its volume. Comparing it with a plain average shows where the real money changed hands.
principle.zh: 按成交量加权的平均价，反映股票实际在什么价位换手。与普通均线对比，能看出真金白银在哪里成交。

example.en: A stock rises from $18 to $21 on fading volume while VWMA20 slips below SMA20: up days are thin, down days heavy. Big holders are quietly selling.
example.zh: 一只股票缩量从 18 涨到 21 美元，VWMA20 却跌破 SMA20：上涨日量小、下跌日量大，大资金在悄悄出货。

formula.en:
TWAP = (sum of closes since the anchor) / (number of bars)
Anchor = session start (intraday) or year start
Every bar counts equally, volume ignored
formula.zh:
TWAP = 锚点以来收盘价之和 / K 线根数
锚点 = 日内取开盘，日线以上取年初
每根 K 线权重相同，不看成交量

principle.en: The plain average price since a starting point, with every bar weighted the same. It is mainly a benchmark for orders that are split into equal slices over time.
principle.zh: 从某个起点开始的简单平均价，每根 K 线权重一样。它主要是「按时间平均拆单」执行的基准价。

example.en: To buy 400,000 shares without moving the price, an algorithm buys about 1,700 shares every minute all day. TWAP is the price it should average.
example.zh: 要买 40 万股又不想推高价格，算法全天每分钟买约 1700 股，TWAP 就是它应该拿到的平均价。

principle.en: The average of four moving averages of different lengths, giving one line that splits bull from bear. Recent bars weigh most, so it behaves like a medium-speed average.
principle.zh: 四条不同周期均线的平均，合成一条「多空分界线」。近期 K 线权重最大，速度介于快慢均线之间。

example.en: Hold while the close is above BBI, step aside below. A stock rising from ¥12 to ¥19 only dips under BBI twice and recovers within two days.
example.zh: 收盘在 BBI 上方就持有，下方就离场。一只从 12 元涨到 19 元的股票只跌破两次，且两天内就收复。

formula.en:
Short group: EMA 3, 5, 8, 10, 12, 15
Long group: EMA 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 60

principle.en: Twelve EMAs in a fast ribbon (traders) and a slow ribbon (investors). A ribbon's width shows how much that group agrees; the gap between ribbons shows how strong the trend is.
principle.zh: 十二条 EMA 分成快带（短线客）和慢带（长线资金）。带的宽度代表群体共识，两带间距代表趋势强弱。

example.en: A stock drops 9% in three days and the fast ribbon collapses, but the slow ribbon stays spread out. That is a shakeout, not a reversal.
example.zh: 一只股票三天跌 9%，快带收拢，但慢带依旧张开——这是洗盘，不是反转。

formula.en:
+DI = 100 × smoothed(+DM) / ATR
−DI = 100 × smoothed(−DM) / ATR
DX = |+DI − −DI| / (+DI + −DI)
ADX = 100 × smoothed(DX, 14)
formula.zh:
+DI = 100 × 平滑(+DM) / ATR
−DI = 100 × 平滑(−DM) / ATR
DX = |+DI − −DI| / (+DI + −DI)
ADX = 100 × 平滑(DX, 14)

principle.en: ADX measures how strong a trend is, not its direction. Below 20 the market is choppy; above 25 it is trending. +DI and −DI tell you which side is winning.
principle.zh: ADX 只衡量趋势有多强，不管方向。低于 20 是震荡，高于 25 是趋势；方向看 +DI 与 −DI 谁在上。

example.en: Like a switch between playbooks: with ADX at 15, buy dips and sell rallies. When ADX climbs past 25 and +DI pulls away, switch to riding the trend.
example.zh: 像一个切换开关：ADX 在 15 时做高抛低吸；ADX 升破 25 且 +DI 拉开差距时，改为顺势持有。

formula.en:
PDI = 100 × Σ(up moves) / Σ(TR)
MDI = 100 × Σ(down moves) / Σ(TR)
ADX = SMA(|MDI − PDI| / (MDI + PDI) × 100, 6)
ADXR = (ADX + ADX six bars ago) / 2
formula.zh:
PDI = 100 × Σ(向上动向) / Σ(TR)
MDI = 100 × Σ(向下动向) / Σ(TR)
ADX = SMA(|MDI − PDI| / (MDI + PDI) × 100, 6)
ADXR = (ADX + 6 根前的 ADX) / 2

principle.en: The same idea as ADX, but using simple rolling sums, so it reacts much faster. PDI above MDI means buyers are pushing the range further than sellers.
principle.zh: 思路与 ADX 相同，但用滚动求和计算，反应快得多。PDI 在 MDI 上方，说明买方推动的幅度大于卖方。

example.en: After a six-week base, a breakout lifts PDI to 34, drops MDI to 11 and ADX jumps from 12 to 41 in four days — two weeks before Wilder's ADX confirms.
example.zh: 横盘六周后突破，四天内 PDI 升到 34、MDI 降到 11、ADX 从 12 跳到 41，比传统 ADX 早两周确认。

formula.en:
DIZ = up deviation / total deviation (13 bars)
DDI = 2·DIZ − 1   (range −1 … +1)
ADDI = smoothed DDI, AD = SMA(ADDI, 5)
formula.zh:
DIZ = 向上偏离 / 总偏离（13 根）
DDI = 2·DIZ − 1（范围 −1 … +1）
ADDI = DDI 的平滑，AD = SMA(ADDI, 5)

principle.en: Over the last 13 bars, what share of directional movement went up versus down. Zero is an even split; +0.6 means about 80% went up. Being bounded, it compares across stocks and years.
principle.zh: 最近 13 根 K 线里，方向性波动有多少向上、多少向下。0 表示各半，+0.6 约等于八成向上；有上下限，可跨股票比较。

example.en: A stock hits a 60-day high while DDI has stayed above +0.5 for eleven of thirteen days: the rally is broad and steady, not two lucky gaps.
example.zh: 一只股票创 60 日新高，DDI 在 13 天里有 11 天高于 +0.5：上涨稳健扎实，不是靠两次跳空。

formula.en:
Up = (n − bars since n-bar high) / n × 100
Down = (n − bars since n-bar low) / n × 100
Default n = 14
formula.zh:
上升线 = (n − 距 n 日最高的根数) / n × 100
下降线 = (n − 距 n 日最低的根数) / n × 100
默认 n = 14

principle.en: Aroon measures time, not price: how many bars ago was the latest high or low? Fresh highs keep Aroon Up near 100, showing the trend is still being pushed.
principle.zh: 阿隆看的是时间而不是价格：最近的高点或低点出现在几根之前？不断创新高，上升线就保持在 100 附近。

example.en: After running from $30 to $42, both lines drift below 50 for five weeks. The day Aroon Up jumps from 30 to 100 is the breakout day.
example.zh: 一只股票从 30 涨到 42 美元后，两条线在 50 以下徘徊五周；上升线从 30 跳到 100 的那天，就是突破日。

formula.en:
X = (C − C₋₁) + 0.5(C − O) + 0.25(C₋₁ − O₋₁)
K = max(|H − C₋₁|, |L − C₋₁|)
SI = 50 × X × K / (R × 3)
R = range term depending on the largest gap
formula.zh:
X = (C − C₋₁) + 0.5(C − O) + 0.25(C₋₁ − O₋₁)
K = max(|H − C₋₁|, |L − C₋₁|)
SI = 50 × X × K / (R × 3)
R = 取决于最大跳空的区间项

principle.en: A single-bar score that says which way the day really swung, combining today's open, high, low and close with yesterday's. It handles gaps more honestly than a simple close-to-close change.
principle.zh: 给单根 K 线打分，综合今天和昨天的开高低收，判断当天真实的摆动方向。对跳空的处理比单纯收盘差更合理。

example.en: A stock closes at $50, gaps down to $46, then rallies to $49.50. Close-to-close says down day; SI scores it positive because buyers won the session.
example.zh: 一只股票昨收 50 美元，今天低开到 46，全天拉回到 49.5。按收盘差是下跌日，SI 却给正分，因为当天买方赢了。

formula.en:
DIFF = C − C₋₁₂
MI = smoothed(DIFF, 12)
formula.zh:
DIFF = C − C₋₁₂
MI = DIFF 的平滑（12）

principle.en: Today's close minus the close 12 bars ago, plus a smoothed line of that gap. Above zero means price is higher than 12 bars ago. It is in price units, so compare a stock only with itself.
principle.zh: 今天收盘价减去 12 根前的收盘价，再配一条平滑线。大于零表示比 12 根前更高；单位是价格，只能和自己比较。

example.en: A stock climbs from $80 to $118 in three legs; DIFF peaks at +9, then +5.5, then +3. Price still rises, but each leg is slower — momentum is fading.
example.zh: 一只股票分三段从 80 涨到 118 美元，DIFF 峰值依次为 +9、+5.5、+3。价格还在涨，但一段比一段慢，动量在衰减。

formula.en:
TR = EMA(EMA(EMA(C, 12), 12), 12)
TRIX = (TR − TR₋₁) / TR₋₁ × 100
TRMA = SMA(TRIX, 20)
formula.zh:
TR = EMA(EMA(EMA(C, 12), 12), 12)
TRIX = (TR − TR₋₁) / TR₋₁ × 100
TRMA = SMA(TRIX, 20)

principle.en: Smooth the price three times with an EMA, then take its daily percentage change. Short-term noise is almost completely filtered out, leaving a slow but very clean trend line.
principle.zh: 价格连做三次 EMA 平滑，再算每日百分比变化。短期噪音几乎被滤光，留下一条慢但非常干净的趋势线。

example.en: On a weekly chart through a two-year rally, TRIX stayed above zero for about 80 weeks, ignoring three 12–15% pullbacks that triggered false MACD sells.
example.zh: 在两年牛市的周线上，TRIX 连续约 80 周保持在零轴上方，无视三次 12–15% 的回调，而 MACD 每次都发出了假卖出信号。

formula.en:
D = SMA(C, 10) − SMA(C, 50)
DMA = SMA(D, 10)
formula.zh:
D = SMA(C, 10) − SMA(C, 50)
DMA = SMA(D, 10)

principle.en: The gap between a 10-bar and a 50-bar simple average, plus a signal line. It is basically MACD built from simple averages: a wider gap means a stronger trend.
principle.zh: 10 日与 50 日简单均线之差，再配一条信号线。本质上就是用简单均线做的 MACD：差距越大，趋势越强。

example.en: On past rallies D topped near +6. Now it hits +9.5 while price barely makes a new high — the trend is stretched and a pullback is likely.
example.zh: 过去几轮上涨 D 都在 +6 左右见顶，这次冲到 +9.5，价格却只是勉强创新高——趋势过度拉伸，回调概率大。

formula.en: PRICEOSC = (SMA(C, 12) − SMA(C, 26)) / SMA(C, 12) × 100
formula.zh: PRICEOSC = (SMA(C, 12) − SMA(C, 26)) / SMA(C, 12) × 100

principle.en: The gap between a fast and a slow average, expressed as a percentage. Because it is a percentage, a $4 stock and a $4,000 index can be compared on the same scale.
principle.zh: 快慢均线的差距，换算成百分比。正因为是百分比，4 元的股票和 4000 点的指数可以放在同一把尺子上比较。

example.en: Rank 200 stocks by PRICEOSC: the top 10% have a 12-day average more than about 4% above the 26-day — a quick list of fast movers.
example.zh: 把 200 只股票按 PRICEOSC 排序，前 10% 的 12 日均线比 26 日均线高出约 4% 以上，就是一份「正在快速上涨」的名单。

formula.en:
TSF = value of the 5-bar regression line
FOSC = (C − TSF₋₁) / C × 100
SIG = SMA(FOSC, 3)
formula.zh:
TSF = 5 根回归直线的值
FOSC = (C − TSF₋₁) / C × 100
SIG = SMA(FOSC, 3)

principle.en: How far today's close landed from where yesterday's trend line said it would be, in percent. A steady trend reads near zero, so it only lights up on surprises.
principle.zh: 今天收盘价偏离昨天趋势线预测值多少（百分比）。匀速趋势读数接近零，只有出现「意外」时才会亮起。

example.en: In a clear uptrend, a pullback prints FOSC −2.8% then −3.1%: price is undershooting the trend. When FOSC turns back up, that is the dip to buy.
example.zh: 明确上升趋势中回调，FOSC 先后为 −2.8%、−3.1%，价格低于趋势预期；FOSC 拐头向上时就是回调买点。

formula.en:
SAR = SAR₋₁ + AF × (EP − SAR₋₁)
EP = extreme price since the last flip
AF starts at 2%, +2% per new extreme, max 20%
Price touches SAR → flip side
formula.zh:
SAR = SAR₋₁ + AF × (EP − SAR₋₁)
EP = 上次转向以来的极值价
AF 起始 2%，每创新极值 +2%，上限 20%
价格触及 SAR → 转向

principle.en: A stop level that creeps toward price a bit faster every time the trend makes a new extreme. It simply says: if price reaches here, the trend is over.
principle.zh: 一个止损位，趋势每创一次新极值，它就更快地向价格靠拢。它只表达一件事：价格碰到这里，趋势就结束了。

example.en: You buy a breakout at 50; over three months the dots rise to 61, 68, 73 as the stock runs to 78. Your stop trails up on its own and locks in most of the gain.
example.zh: 你在 50 元突破时买入，三个月涨到 78，SAR 点位依次上移到 61、68、73，止损自动跟随，锁住大部分利润。

formula.en:
MID = (H + L) / 2
Upper = MID + 3 × ATR(10)
Lower = MID − 3 × ATR(10)
Line only moves in the trend's favour; flips when crossed
formula.zh:
中值 = (H + L) / 2
上轨 = 中值 + 3 × ATR(10)
下轨 = 中值 − 3 × ATR(10)
线只朝有利方向移动，被穿越即翻转

principle.en: A trailing line set a few ATRs away from price that only ratchets in the trend's direction. Because the distance is based on volatility, it gives jumpy markets more room.
principle.zh: 一条离价格几个 ATR 的跟踪线，只朝趋势方向移动。距离按波动率设定，所以波动大的品种会自动给更多空间。

example.en: A contract at 4,200 with ATR 45 has its line near 4,065. Price grinds to 4,600 and the line ratchets to 4,455 without ever moving down.
example.zh: 某合约 4200 点、ATR 为 45，线在 4065 附近。价格涨到 4600，线随之抬到 4455，从未下移。

formula.en:
MID = (H + L) / 2
Jaw = SMMA(MID, 13), shifted 8 bars
Teeth = SMMA(MID, 8), shifted 5 bars
Lips = SMMA(MID, 5), shifted 3 bars
formula.zh:
中值 = (H + L) / 2
颚线 = SMMA(中值, 13)，右移 8 根
齿线 = SMMA(中值, 8)，右移 5 根
唇线 = SMMA(中值, 5)，右移 3 根

principle.en: Three smoothed averages, each shifted forward. When they are tangled the alligator is asleep (no trend); when they fan out in order it is eating (trend).
principle.zh: 三条平滑均线，各自向右平移。三线缠绕时鳄鱼在睡觉（无趋势），按顺序张开时鳄鱼在进食（有趋势）。

example.en: A currency pair ranges for six weeks with the lines knotted within 20 pips. A crossover system fires eight times; the Alligator keeps you out until the lines fan.
example.zh: 某货币对横盘六周，三线缠在 20 点内。均线交叉系统发了八次信号，鳄鱼线让你一直等到三线张开。

formula.en:
Fit y = a + b·x over the last 9 closes
TSF = a + b·(n − 1) + b·k   (k = 6)
formula.zh:
对最近 9 根收盘价拟合 y = a + b·x
TSF = a + b·(n − 1) + b·k（k = 6）

principle.en: Draw the best-fit straight line through recent closes, then extend it a few bars ahead. It shows where the trend says price is heading, with much less lag than an average.
principle.zh: 对近期收盘价画一条最佳拟合直线，再向前延伸几根，表示趋势指向哪里。滞后比均线小得多。

example.en: An ETF bases at 395–402 and then closes 399, 401, 403. A 9-bar SMA is still flat, but TSF's slope turns sharply up — the trend change shows days earlier.
example.zh: 某 ETF 在 395–402 横盘后收出 399、401、403，9 日均线仍然走平，TSF 斜率却已明显向上，提前几天发现转势。

formula.en:
TOWER = C − C₋₂
Red if C ≥ C₋₂, green if C < C₋₂
formula.zh:
宝塔线 = C − C₋₂
C ≥ C₋₂ 为红，C < C₋₂ 为绿

principle.en: A chart that keeps only closing prices. A bar turns green only when the close breaks the close of two bars back, so a single down day inside a rally is ignored.
principle.zh: 只保留收盘价的图形。只有收盘价跌破两根前的收盘价才翻绿，所以上涨途中的单日小跌会被忽略。

example.en: A stock runs from 12 to 19 with eleven red bars in a row. The first green bar prints at 18.2 — a rule-following trader exits there and keeps most of the move.
example.zh: 一只股票从 12 元涨到 19 元，连续 11 根红柱，第一根绿柱出现在 18.2 元。守纪律离场，就保住了大部分涨幅。

formula.en:
haC = (O + H + L + C) / 4
haO = (haO₋₁ + haC₋₁) / 2
HADIFF = haC − haO
HADMA = SMA(HADIFF, 3)
formula.zh:
haC = (O + H + L + C) / 4
haO = (haO₋₁ + haC₋₁) / 2
HADIFF = haC − haO
HADMA = SMA(HADIFF, 3)

principle.en: The body of a Heikin Ashi candle, drawn as a histogram. Because it uses averaged prices, it stays positive through a trend and flips sign only reluctantly.
principle.zh: 把平均足蜡烛的实体画成柱状图。由于用的是平均价，趋势中它会一直保持同一方向，不轻易翻转。

example.en: Holding a stock from 60 to 82, normal candles show four red days that tempt you to sell. HADIFF stays positive the whole way and keeps you in.
example.zh: 持有一只从 60 涨到 82 的股票，普通 K 线出现四根阴线诱你卖出，HADIFF 却始终为正，让你拿住。

formula.en:
BB_upper = SMA(C, 20) + 2σ
KC_upper = EMA(C, 20) + 1 × EMA(TR, 20)
Squeeze on when BB_upper < KC_upper
Momentum = regression of (C − mid of range)
formula.zh:
布林上轨 = SMA(C, 20) + 2σ
肯特纳上轨 = EMA(C, 20) + 1 × EMA(TR, 20)
布林上轨 < 肯特纳上轨 → 挤压开启
动量 = (C − 区间中值) 的回归值

principle.en: When Bollinger Bands shrink inside Keltner Channels, volatility is unusually low, and a big move often follows. A momentum histogram hints at which way it will break.
principle.zh: 布林带缩进肯特纳通道内，说明波动率异常低，往往酝酿大行情；动量柱提示可能向哪个方向突破。

example.en: A stock sits in a 3% range for a month and the squeeze is on for 18 days while momentum bars grow positive. When the squeeze releases, it breaks upward.
example.zh: 一只股票在 3% 区间里横了一个月，挤压持续 18 天，动量柱逐渐变高为正；挤压一解除，股价向上突破。

formula.en:
z = position of (H + L)/2 within its 9-bar range, 0…1
v = 0.67 × (z − 0.5) + 0.66 × v₋₁
Fisher = 0.5 × ln((1 + v) / (1 − v)) + 0.5 × Fisher₋₁
Trigger = Fisher₋₁

principle.en: Takes where price sits in its recent range and stretches the extremes with a log formula. Turning points become sharp spikes, so rare readings really are rare.
principle.zh: 先算价格在近期区间的位置，再用对数公式把两端拉伸。拐点变成尖峰，极端读数真正少见。

example.en: A currency pair ranging for three weeks sells off four days into support. Fisher spikes below −2, then crosses its trigger line upward: a clear bounce signal.
example.zh: 某货币对震荡三周后连跌四天到支撑位，费雪值冲到 −2 以下，随后上穿触发线，给出清晰的反弹信号。

formula.en:
MID = (H + L) / 2
AO = SMA(MID, 5) − SMA(MID, 34)
formula.zh:
中值 = (H + L) / 2
AO = SMA(中值, 5) − SMA(中值, 34)

principle.en: The gap between a 5-bar and a 34-bar average of each bar's midpoint. It reads medium-term momentum; crossing zero marks a shift in trend.
principle.zh: 每根 K 线中值的 5 日均线减去 34 日均线，反映中期动量；穿越零轴代表趋势转换。

example.en: A stock rallies to 60, dips to 55, then pushes to a new high at 62, but AO peaks lower the second time. Momentum is weakening under the new high.
example.zh: 一只股票涨到 60、回落到 55、再创新高到 62，但第二次 AO 峰值更低——新高背后动量已经减弱。

formula.en: EWO = EMA(C, 5) − EMA(C, 34)
formula.zh: EWO = EMA(C, 5) − EMA(C, 34)

principle.en: The gap between a 5- and a 34-period EMA, used to help count Elliott waves. Wave 3 usually shows the biggest reading; wave 5 makes a new high on a smaller one.
principle.zh: 5 日与 34 日 EMA 之差，用来辅助数浪。第三浪通常读数最大，第五浪价格创新高但读数更小。

example.en: A rally from 100 to 120 showed the biggest EWO bars; the next push to 125 shows much smaller bars. That fits wave 5 — the trend is likely near its end.
example.zh: 从 100 涨到 120 时 EWO 柱最高，再冲到 125 时柱子明显变矮，符合第五浪特征，趋势可能接近尾声。

formula.en:
TR = max(H − L, |H − C₋₁|, |L − C₋₁|)
ATR = SMA(TR, 14)
Stop distance = k × ATR
Position size = risk $ / (k × ATR)
formula.zh:
TR = max(H − L, |H − C₋₁|, |L − C₋₁|)
ATR = SMA(TR, 14)
止损距离 = k × ATR
仓位 = 风险金额 / (k × ATR)

principle.en: The average size of a daily move in price units, counting gaps. It says nothing about direction; it tells you how much a stock normally wiggles, which sets stops and position size.
principle.zh: 每天平均波动多少（含跳空），以价格为单位。它不管方向，只告诉你股票正常晃动幅度，用来定止损和仓位。

example.en: Risking $500 with a 2×ATR stop: a $40 stock with ATR 1.20 gives 208 shares; one with ATR 0.30 gives 833. Same risk, very different size.
example.zh: 每笔风险 500 美元、止损 2 倍 ATR：ATR 为 1.2 的 40 美元股票买 208 股，ATR 为 0.3 的买 833 股。风险相同，仓位差很多。

formula.en:
r = ln(C / C₋₁)
VOLAT = StdDev(r, 20) × √252 × 100
One-day move ≈ VOLAT / 16 %
formula.zh:
r = ln(C / C₋₁)
VOLAT = StdDev(r, 20) × √252 × 100
单日波动 ≈ VOLAT / 16 %

principle.en: How widely daily returns have scattered recently, scaled to a yearly percentage. It speaks the same language as option prices, so you can compare it with implied volatility.
principle.zh: 近期每日涨跌幅的离散程度，换算成年化百分比。它和期权报价用同一种语言，可以直接与隐含波动率对比。

example.en: A stock moves with 14% historical volatility while its options price in 34%. Options are charging more than twice the actual movement — they look expensive.
example.zh: 一只股票实际波动率 14%，期权却按 34% 定价，相当于收了两倍多的「波动费」，期权明显偏贵。

formula.en:
HLD = HHV(H, 9) − LLV(L, 9)
HLVOL = EMA(HLD, 9) / EMA(C, 9) × 100
formula.zh:
HLD = HHV(H, 9) − LLV(L, 9)
HLVOL = EMA(HLD, 9) / EMA(C, 9) × 100

principle.en: The height of the recent high-low box as a percentage of price. A falling reading means the box is shrinking and price is coiling.
principle.zh: 近期最高最低价构成的「箱体」高度，占价格的百分比。读数下降说明箱体在收窄、价格在蓄势。

example.en: Scan 100 stocks: names at 3–4% trade in a tight box, names at 18% are wide open. A stock dropping from 12% to 4% is a coil worth watching for a breakout.
example.zh: 扫描 100 只股票：3–4% 的在窄箱里，18% 的波动很大。从 12% 降到 4% 的股票正在蓄势，值得盯住突破。

formula.en:
CHOP = 100 × log(ΣTR(n) / (HHV(H, n) − LLV(L, n))) / log(n)
Above 61.8 = choppy, below 38.2 = trending
formula.zh:
CHOP = 100 × log(ΣTR(n) / (HHV(H, n) − LLV(L, n))) / log(n)
高于 61.8 为震荡，低于 38.2 为趋势

principle.en: Compares the total distance price walked with the distance it actually covered. Near 100, price paced around the room; near 0, it walked straight somewhere. It ignores direction.
principle.zh: 比较价格「走过的总路程」和「实际位移」。接近 100 是在原地兜圈，接近 0 是直线前进。不看方向。

example.en: Add one rule to a losing crossover system: only trade when CHOP is below 45. It cuts trades roughly in half and removes most of the whipsaws.
example.zh: 给一个亏钱的均线交叉系统加一条规则：CHOP 低于 45 才交易。交易次数约减半，大部分来回打脸的信号消失了。

formula.en:
net = |C − C₋ₙ|
path = Σ|C − C₋₁| over n bars
ER = net / path, from 0 to 1   (n = 24)
formula.zh:
净位移 = |C − C₋ₙ|
总路程 = n 根内 Σ|C − C₋₁|
ER = 净位移 / 总路程，范围 0 到 1（n = 24）

principle.en: How much of the movement actually went somewhere: net change divided by total wiggling. 1 is a straight line, 0 means price ended where it started.
principle.zh: 价格的波动里有多少是「有效前进」：净变化除以总路程。1 是一条直线，0 表示绕了一圈回到原点。

example.en: Like a GPS route: driving 10 km to get 5 km away is ER 0.5 — half the trip was wasted on back-and-forth.
example.zh: 像导航路线：开了 10 公里才离起点 5 公里，ER 就是 0.5，一半路程浪费在来回绕上。

formula.en:
σ = StdDev(C, 10)
UP = EMA(σ on up days, 14), DOWN = EMA(σ on down days, 14)
RVI = UP / (UP + DOWN) × 100
RVIMA = SMA(RVI, 14)
formula.zh:
σ = StdDev(C, 10)
上行 = EMA(上涨日的 σ, 14)，下行 = EMA(下跌日的 σ, 14)
RVI = 上行 / (上行 + 下行) × 100
RVIMA = SMA(RVI, 14)

principle.en: Like RSI, but it counts volatility instead of price change: what share of recent volatility happened on up days. Above 50 means the big moves are upward.
principle.zh: 类似 RSI，但统计的是波动率：近期波动有多少发生在上涨日。高于 50 说明大波动多出现在上涨方向。

example.en: A stock breaks to a 50-day high, but RVI sits at 38 and is falling: the big bars lately were down bars. Treat the breakout with suspicion.
example.zh: 一只股票创 50 日新高，但 RVI 只有 38 且在下降，说明近期大 K 线多是阴线，这次突破要打个问号。

formula.en:
mom = C − C₋₅
RMI = SMA(max(mom, 0), 20) / SMA(|mom|, 20) × 100
Levels: 70 / 50 / 30
formula.zh:
mom = C − C₋₅
RMI = SMA(max(mom, 0), 20) / SMA(|mom|, 20) × 100
参考线：70 / 50 / 30

principle.en: RSI measured over 5-bar changes instead of 1-bar changes. Single-day reversals stop counting, so the line is smoother and stays in trend longer.
principle.zh: 把 RSI 的一日涨跌换成五日涨跌来算。单日的反复不再计入，曲线更平滑，在趋势中停留更久。

example.en: In a slow, steady eight-week climb, RSI keeps dipping to 45 on one-day shakeouts, while RMI holds above 60 the whole time.
example.zh: 在八周的缓慢稳步上涨中，RSI 每次单日洗盘都掉到 45，RMI 却始终守在 60 以上。

formula.en:
ΔC = C − C₋₁
SMI = EMA(EMA(ΔC, 5), 20) / EMA(EMA(|ΔC|, 5), 20)
Signal = EMA(SMI, 5)
formula.zh:
ΔC = C − C₋₁
SMI = EMA(EMA(ΔC, 5), 20) / EMA(EMA(|ΔC|, 5), 20)
信号线 = EMA(SMI, 5)

principle.en: Net price change divided by total price change, both smoothed twice. The result runs from −1 to +1 and is a very clean momentum line.
principle.zh: 净涨跌除以总涨跌，两者都经过两次平滑，结果在 −1 到 +1 之间，是一条非常干净的动量线。

example.en: During a decline, price makes a lower low but SMI's low is clearly higher. Because the line is so smooth, this divergence is real, not a squiggle.
example.zh: 下跌中价格创新低，SMI 的低点却明显抬高。由于曲线很平滑，这种背离是真实的，不是随手画出来的。

formula.en: SMIEO = SMI − Signal
formula.zh: SMIEO = SMI − 信号线

principle.en: The gap between the SMI line and its signal line, drawn as a histogram. Like the MACD histogram, it shows whether momentum is speeding up or slowing down.
principle.zh: SMI 线与信号线之差，画成柱状图。和 MACD 柱一样，显示动量在加速还是放缓。

example.en: SMI at 0.62 and signal at 0.60 look identical as lines, but as bars you can see three shrinking columns while price still rises — a fading push.
example.zh: SMI 为 0.62、信号线 0.60，两条线几乎重合；画成柱子却能看到价格上涨时柱子连缩三根，推力在减弱。

formula.en:
DIFF = EMA(V, 12) − EMA(V, 26)
DEA = EMA(DIFF, 9)
VMACD = DIFF − DEA
formula.zh:
DIFF = EMA(V, 12) − EMA(V, 26)
DEA = EMA(DIFF, 9)
VMACD = DIFF − DEA

principle.en: MACD applied to volume instead of price. It shows whether participation is rising above or falling below its usual level, but not whether that volume is buying or selling.
principle.zh: 把 MACD 套在成交量上，看参与度是高于还是低于常态。它不区分这些量是买还是卖。

example.en: After four months of falling prices on shrinking volume, price makes a slight new low while DIFF turns sharply up: buyers are arriving at the bottom.
example.zh: 缩量下跌四个月后，价格小幅新低，DIFF 却急剧拐头向上——底部开始有资金进场。

formula.en:
mid = % change of (H + L) from the previous bar
EMV = SMA(mid × SMA(V)/V × (H − L)/SMA(H − L), 14)
EMVA = SMA(EMV, 9)
formula.zh:
中值变化 = (H + L) 相对前一根的百分比变化
EMV = SMA(中值变化 × SMA(V)/V × (H − L)/SMA(H − L), 14)
EMVA = SMA(EMV, 9)

principle.en: How far price moved per unit of volume. A big move on light volume means little resistance; a big move on heavy volume means a fight for every tick.
principle.zh: 每单位成交量推动了多少价格。缩量大涨说明阻力小；放量才涨得动，说明每一步都在硬拼。

example.en: Like a car on an empty road versus a traffic jam: a stock jumps 3% out of a six-month base on below-average volume. EMV spikes — there's no supply in the way.
example.zh: 就像空荡的马路和堵车：一只股票缩量涨 3% 突破半年箱体，EMV 急升，说明上方几乎没有抛压。

formula.en:
Option price = BlackScholes(S, K, T, r, σ)
IV = the σ that matches the market price
IV − HV = volatility risk premium
formula.zh:
期权价格 = BlackScholes(S, K, T, r, σ)
IV = 使模型价格等于市价的 σ
IV − HV = 波动率风险溢价

principle.en: The volatility that makes an option model match the option's market price. It is the market's forecast of future movement — the only forward-looking line on the chart.
principle.zh: 让期权模型算出的价格等于市价的那个波动率。它是市场对未来波动的预期，是图上唯一「向前看」的指标。

example.en: Four days before earnings, IV jumps from 32% to 68% while actual volatility is 28%. After the report IV usually collapses — option sellers profit from that crush.
example.zh: 财报前四天 IV 从 32% 升到 68%，实际波动只有 28%。财报一出 IV 通常暴跌，期权卖方赚的就是这一跌。

formula.en: IVR = (IV − 1-year low) / (1-year high − 1-year low) × 100
formula.zh: IVR = (IV − 一年最低) / (一年最高 − 一年最低) × 100

principle.en: Where today's IV sits between its lowest and highest level of the past year, from 0 to 100. It tells you if options are cheap or expensive for this particular stock.
principle.zh: 今天的 IV 在过去一年最低到最高之间处于什么位置，0 到 100。它告诉你这只股票的期权此刻是贵还是便宜。

example.en: A utility at 22% IV ranged 14–24% this year: IVR 80, expensive. A chip stock at 48% ranged 40–90%: IVR 16, cheap. The lower IV is the richer premium.
example.zh: 某公用事业股 IV 22%，一年区间 14–24%，排名 80 偏贵；某芯片股 IV 48%，区间 40–90%，排名 16 偏便宜。

formula.en:
IVP = (days in the past year with IV ≤ today) / (n − 1) × 100
n = 252
formula.zh:
IVP = 过去一年 IV ≤ 今日的天数 / (n − 1) × 100
n = 252

principle.en: The share of days in the past year when IV was lower than today. It counts days instead of measuring distance from extremes, so one crisis spike can't distort it.
principle.zh: 过去一年里 IV 低于今天的天数占比。它数的是天数而不是距离两端的远近，所以一次危机尖峰扭曲不了它。

example.en: After a crisis spike to 180%, today's 46% gives an IV Rank of 8 (looks cheap). But IV was below 46% on 88% of days — IVP 88 says options are actually expensive.
example.zh: 危机时 IV 冲到 180%，今天 46% 的 IV 排名只有 8，看似便宜；但一年里 88% 的日子 IV 都低于 46%，IVP 为 88，其实很贵。

formula.en:
RSV = (C − LLV(L, 9)) / (HHV(H, 9) − LLV(L, 9)) × 100
K = SMMA(RSV, 3)
D = SMMA(K, 3)
J = 3K − 2D
formula.zh:
RSV = (C − LLV(L, 9)) / (HHV(H, 9) − LLV(L, 9)) × 100
K = SMMA(RSV, 3)
D = SMMA(K, 3)
J = 3K − 2D

principle.en: Where today's close sits in the last nine days' range: 0 at the floor, 100 at the ceiling. K and D smooth it; J exaggerates their gap and can break below 0 or above 100.
principle.zh: 今天收盘价在最近九天区间里的位置：0 在底部，100 在顶部。K、D 是平滑结果，J 放大两者差距，可以跌破 0 或超过 100。

example.en: A stock in an uptrend pulls back from ¥26 to ¥23.5 on light volume; J dips to −6. When K crosses back above D, it is a well-timed entry.
example.zh: 上升趋势中的股票缩量从 26 元回调到 23.5 元，J 值跌到 −6；K 重新上穿 D 时，就是一个时机不错的买点。

name.zh: 慢速随机指标（慢速 KD）

formula.en:
FastK = SMMA(RSV, 3)
K = SMMA(FastK, 3)
D = SMMA(K, 5)
RSV as in KDJ, N = 9
formula.zh:
快 K = SMMA(RSV, 3)
K = SMMA(快 K, 3)
D = SMMA(K, 5)
RSV 同 KDJ，N = 9

principle.en: The same range position as KDJ with one more layer of smoothing. You get fewer, later crossovers but far fewer false ones.
principle.zh: 和 KDJ 测的是同一个位置，只是多平滑了一层。交叉信号更少、更晚，但假信号也少得多。

example.en: On a jumpy small-cap over two months, KDJ crossed eleven times and nine failed within three bars. Slow KD crossed four times, and the two buys worked.
example.zh: 一只波动剧烈的小盘股两个月里，KDJ 交叉 11 次，9 次三天内就失效；慢速 KD 只交叉 4 次，两次买入都成功了。

formula.en:
STOCH = (RSI − min RSI(14)) / (max RSI(14) − min RSI(14)) × 100
K = SMA(STOCH, 3)
D = SMA(K, 3)
formula.zh:
STOCH = (RSI − 14 日 RSI 最低) / (14 日 RSI 最高 − 14 日 RSI 最低) × 100
K = SMA(STOCH, 3)
D = SMA(K, 3)

principle.en: A stochastic applied to RSI: where today's RSI sits within its own recent range. It magnifies small RSI moves, so it turns early but is very jumpy.
principle.zh: 对 RSI 再做一次随机指标：今天的 RSI 在它自己近期区间里的位置。它放大了 RSI 的小波动，转向早但非常敏感。

example.en: A stock bases at ¥54 support with RSI stuck at 42, never reaching 30. StochRSI ranks that 42 near the bottom of its range at 8 — and turns up first.
example.zh: 一只股票在 54 元支撑位横盘，RSI 停在 42 始终到不了 30；StochRSI 却显示 8，处在区间底部，并率先拐头。

formula.en:
EM = EMA(C, 6)
SRSI = SMA(max(C − EM, 0), 14) / SMA(|C − EM|, 14) × 100
formula.zh:
EM = EMA(C, 6)
SRSI = SMA(max(C − EM, 0), 14) / SMA(|C − EM|, 14) × 100

principle.en: Despite the name, it uses RSI maths on the gap between price and its 6-day EMA. It shows how persistently price has stayed above or below that average.
principle.zh: 名字叫慢速 RSI，实际是用 RSI 的算法去算价格与 6 日 EMA 的偏离，衡量价格持续在均线上方或下方的程度。

example.en: A stock closes above its 6-EMA for 14 straight days rising from ¥88 to ¥97, so SRSI sits at 100. The first tick down to 93 flags the streak has broken.
example.zh: 一只股票从 88 元涨到 97 元，连续 14 天收在 6 日 EMA 上方，SRSI 一直是 100；一旦降到 93，说明连续强势被打破。

formula.en:
RSI₁ = RSI(C, 3)
RSI₂ = RSI(up/down streak length, 2)
RANK = percentile of today's return in the last 100
CRSI = (RSI₁ + RSI₂ + RANK) / 3
formula.zh:
RSI₁ = RSI(C, 3)
RSI₂ = RSI(连涨连跌天数, 2)
RANK = 今日涨跌幅在近 100 天中的百分位
CRSI = (RSI₁ + RSI₂ + RANK) / 3

principle.en: Averages three short-term readings: momentum, how many days in a row price has moved one way, and how unusual today's move is. Low readings flag a short-term overreaction.
principle.zh: 把三个短期读数平均：动量、连涨或连跌了几天、今天的涨跌有多罕见。读数很低说明短期反应过度。

example.en: An ETF above its rising 200-day line falls four days in a row, the last −2.1%. CRSI drops near 10 — a classic short-term bounce buy.
example.zh: 一只 ETF 位于上行的 200 日均线之上，连跌四天，最后一天跌 2.1%，CRSI 降到 10 左右——典型的短线反弹买点。

formula.en:
%R = −100 × (HHV(H, 14) − C) / (HHV(H, 14) − LLV(L, 14))
Range: −100 (bottom) to 0 (top)

principle.en: Where the close sits in the 14-bar high-low range, with no smoothing at all. 0 means it closed at the top, −100 at the bottom. Fastest possible reading, but noisy.
principle.zh: 收盘价在 14 根 K 线高低区间中的位置，完全不做平滑。0 表示收在最高，−100 表示收在最低。最快，但也最吵。

example.en: A stock ranging ¥62–68 dips to ¥61.6 intraday but closes at ¥64.2. %R jumps from −96 to −38 that same day — the turn shows on the bar it happens.
example.zh: 一只在 62–68 元震荡的股票盘中跌到 61.6 元，收盘回到 64.2 元，%R 当天就从 −96 跳到 −38，当根 K 线就显示反转。

formula.en:
TYP = (H + L + C) / 3
CCI = (TYP − SMA(TYP, 14)) / (0.015 × mean deviation)
formula.zh:
TYP = (H + L + C) / 3
CCI = (TYP − SMA(TYP, 14)) / (0.015 × 平均绝对偏差)

principle.en: How far the typical price sits from its average, measured in units of its usual deviation. It has no ceiling, so a reading of +300 really is far more extreme than +150.
principle.zh: 典型价格偏离均值多远，以它平常的偏离幅度为单位。没有上限，所以 +300 确实比 +150 极端得多。

example.en: A commodity chopping with CCI peaks near ±120 suddenly hits +290 on a supply headline. That is almost triple the normal stretch — a real breakout, not noise.
example.zh: 某商品震荡时 CCI 峰值约 ±120，一条供给消息让它冲到 +290，几乎是平常的三倍，是真突破而不是噪音。

formula.en:
SU = sum of up moves (9 bars)
SD = sum of down moves (9 bars)
CMO = (SU − SD) / (SU + SD) × 100
formula.zh:
SU = 上涨幅度之和（9 根）
SD = 下跌幅度之和（9 根）
CMO = (SU − SD) / (SU + SD) × 100

principle.en: Up movement minus down movement, divided by all movement, on a −100 to +100 scale. It is like an unsmoothed RSI centred on zero, so it reacts faster.
principle.zh: 上涨幅度减下跌幅度，再除以总幅度，范围 −100 到 +100。相当于不做平滑、以零为中心的 RSI，反应更快。

example.en: CMO near +100 means almost every bar in the window went up — a highly efficient trend. Near 0 means lots of activity but no progress.
example.zh: CMO 接近 +100，说明窗口里几乎每根 K 线都在涨，趋势效率极高；接近 0 则是动静很大却原地踏步。

formula.en:
PC = C − C₋₁
TSI = EMA(EMA(PC, 25), 13) / EMA(EMA(|PC|, 25), 13) × 100
Signal = EMA(TSI, 13)
formula.zh:
PC = C − C₋₁
TSI = EMA(EMA(PC, 25), 13) / EMA(EMA(|PC|, 25), 13) × 100
信号线 = EMA(TSI, 13)

principle.en: Price change divided by the size of price change, both smoothed twice. The result is a very smooth line from −100 to +100 showing how consistently price has moved one way.
principle.zh: 价格变化除以变化幅度，两者都平滑两次。得到一条很平滑的 −100 到 +100 曲线，反映价格朝一个方向走得有多一致。

example.en: Price makes three lower lows over nine weeks, but TSI makes three higher lows. Because TSI is so smooth, that divergence is clear and trustworthy.
example.zh: 九周内价格三次创新低，TSI 的低点却三次抬高。TSI 很平滑，这种背离清晰可信。

formula.en:
TYP = (H + L + C) / 3, FLOW = TYP × V
MR = Σ FLOW on up bars / Σ FLOW on down bars (14)
MFI = 100 − 100 / (1 + MR)
formula.zh:
TYP = (H + L + C) / 3，资金流 = TYP × V
MR = 上涨日资金流之和 / 下跌日资金流之和（14 根）
MFI = 100 − 100 / (1 + MR)

principle.en: RSI weighted by volume: a move on heavy trading counts more than one on light trading. It shows whether money, not just price, is flowing in or out.
principle.zh: 按成交量加权的 RSI：放量的涨跌比缩量的更重要。它反映的是资金在流入还是流出，而不只是价格涨跌。

example.en: A stock makes highs at ¥52, ¥53.5 and ¥54.2, but MFI reads 86, 71, then 58. Each new high is bought with less money — a classic distribution top.
example.zh: 一只股票先后创出 52、53.5、54.2 元的新高，MFI 却依次为 86、71、58，每次新高的资金越来越少，是典型的出货顶部。

formula.en:
RVGI = SMA(smoothed(C − O), 10) / SMA(smoothed(H − L), 10)
Smoothing = (x + 2x₋₁ + 2x₋₂ + x₋₃) / 6
Signal = smoothed(RVGI)
formula.zh:
RVGI = SMA(平滑(C − O), 10) / SMA(平滑(H − L), 10)
平滑 = (x + 2x₋₁ + 2x₋₂ + x₋₃) / 6
信号线 = 平滑(RVGI)

principle.en: How much of each bar's range the body covers, and in which direction. In healthy rallies bars close near their highs; when closes drift back toward the open, conviction is fading.
principle.zh: 每根 K 线的实体占整个振幅的比例及方向。健康上涨时收盘接近最高；收盘越来越靠近开盘，说明信心在减弱。

example.en: A stock rising for six weeks reads around +0.35. Then price adds 2% more, but closes land mid-bar and RVGI slides toward zero: a top is forming.
example.zh: 一只股票上涨六周，RVGI 约 +0.35；之后价格又涨 2%，但收盘落在 K 线中部，RVGI 滑向零——顶部正在形成。

formula.en:
BOP = (C − O) / (H − L)
Range −1 to +1, no smoothing
formula.zh:
BOP = (C − O) / (H − L)
范围 −1 到 +1，不做平滑

principle.en: How much of a single bar's range the body covers, and in which direction. +1 opened at the low and closed at the high; 0 is a doji. It describes one candle, with no memory.
principle.zh: 单根 K 线的实体占振幅多少、朝哪个方向。+1 表示开在最低、收在最高，0 是十字星。它只描述一根 K 线，没有记忆。

example.en: On a fourth test of ¥30 support, a bar dips to ¥29.4, opens ¥29.6 and closes ¥30.9. BOP = +0.87: buyers clearly won the day.
example.zh: 第四次测试 30 元支撑，K 线最低 29.4 元，开 29.6 元、收 30.9 元，BOP = +0.87，当天买方明显获胜。

formula.en:
VD = V − V₋₁
VRSI = SMMA(max(VD, 0), N) / SMMA(|VD|, N) × 100
N = 6, 12, 24
formula.zh:
VD = V − V₋₁
VRSI = SMMA(max(VD, 0), N) / SMMA(|VD|, N) × 100
N = 6、12、24

principle.en: RSI applied to volume instead of price. It shows whether trading activity is growing or shrinking, but not whether that activity is buying or selling.
principle.zh: 把 RSI 用在成交量上，显示交易活跃度在放大还是萎缩；但它分不清这些量是买还是卖。

example.en: A quiet stock drifts in a 6% band for months with VRSI(24) under 45. It climbs to 62 while price barely moves — someone is quietly building a position.
example.zh: 一只冷门股在 6% 区间横了几个月，VRSI(24) 一直低于 45；后来升到 62，价格却几乎没动——有人在悄悄建仓。

formula.en:
ROC = (C − C₋₁₂) / C₋₁₂ × 100
ROCMA = SMA(ROC, 6)
formula.zh:
ROC = (C − C₋₁₂) / C₋₁₂ × 100
ROCMA = SMA(ROC, 6)

principle.en: The percentage change from N bars ago to today. Being a percentage, it compares fairly across stocks and years; it only looks at the start and end, not the path.
principle.zh: 今天相对 N 根之前涨跌了百分之几。百分比可以跨股票、跨年份比较；它只看起点和终点，不看过程。

example.en: Rank 40 stocks by 6-month ROC and hold the top 10% while it stays above zero. That is the classic momentum strategy used in academic research.
example.zh: 把 40 只股票按半年 ROC 排序，持有前 10% 且 ROC 为正的那些——这就是学术研究里经典的动量策略。

formula.en:
MTM = C − C₋₁₂
MTMMA = SMA(MTM, 6)
formula.zh:
MTM = C − C₋₁₂
MTMMA = SMA(MTM, 6)

principle.en: Today's close minus the close N bars ago, in price units. It shows the same thing as ROC, but in money rather than percent.
principle.zh: 今天收盘价减去 N 根前的收盘价，单位是价格。和 ROC 表达同一件事，只是用金额而不是百分比。

example.en: On an index future, MTM(12) at +180 means the last twelve sessions gained 180 points — easy to compare with your stop distance in points.
example.zh: 在股指期货上，MTM(12) 为 +180 表示过去 12 个交易日涨了 180 点，可以直接和你按点数设的止损比较。

formula.en:
OSC = 100 × (C − SMA(C, 20))
OSCEMA = EMA(OSC, 6)
formula.zh:
OSC = 100 × (C − SMA(C, 20))
OSCEMA = EMA(OSC, 6)

principle.en: The gap between price and its 20-bar average, multiplied by 100. It is BIAS without the division, so the scale depends on the stock's price and can't be compared across names.
principle.zh: 价格与 20 日均线的差再乘以 100。相当于没有做除法的乖离率，数值大小取决于股价，不能跨股票比较。

example.en: On an index future that has hovered near 4,000 for months, OSC above +3,000 has repeatedly marked short-term tops. Move to a different price level and that rule breaks.
example.zh: 某股指期货几个月都在 4000 点附近，OSC 超过 +3000 多次对应短期顶部；价格水平一变，这条经验就失效了。

formula.en:
DPO = C − SMA(C, 20) shifted back 11 bars
MADPO = SMA(DPO, 6)
formula.zh:
DPO = C − 回移 11 根的 SMA(C, 20)
MADPO = SMA(DPO, 6)

principle.en: Price minus a moving average shifted back by half its length. This removes the trend and leaves the repeating waves, so you can see cycles.
principle.zh: 价格减去向回平移半个周期的均线。这样就去掉了趋势，只剩下反复出现的波动，便于观察周期。

example.en: On weekly heating oil, DPO(40) peaks line up about 52 weeks apart — the seasonal cycle shows up clearly once the trend is removed.
example.zh: 在取暖油周线上，DPO(40) 的峰值大约每隔 52 周出现一次——去掉趋势后，季节性周期一目了然。

formula.en:
BIAS(N) = (C − MA(N)) / MA(N) × 100
Common: BIAS6, BIAS12, BIAS24
formula.zh:
BIAS(N) = (C − MA(N)) / MA(N) × 100
常用：BIAS6、BIAS12、BIAS24

principle.en: How far price has stretched from its moving average, in percent. Like a rubber band: the further it stretches, the more likely it snaps back.
principle.zh: 价格偏离均线的百分比。就像橡皮筋，拉得越远，越容易弹回来。

example.en: A large cap in an uptrend drops 9% in four days; BIAS6 hits −7.5%, an 18-month low, while BIAS24 is still positive. A short-term overreaction worth buying.
example.zh: 一只上升趋势中的大盘股四天跌 9%，BIAS6 达到 −7.5%（18 个月最低），BIAS24 仍为正——短期超跌，值得买入。

formula.en:
B36 = SMA(C, 3) − SMA(C, 6)
B612 = SMA(C, 6) − SMA(C, 12)
formula.zh:
B36 = SMA(C, 3) − SMA(C, 6)
B612 = SMA(C, 6) − SMA(C, 12)

principle.en: Two gaps between short moving averages: 3 vs 6 and 6 vs 12 bars. It shows very quickly whether short-term push is speeding up or fading.
principle.zh: 两组短均线之差：3 日对 6 日、6 日对 12 日。能非常快地看出短线推力在加速还是减弱。

example.en: After a stock runs up nine days, B36 turning down through zero flags lost thrust days before a 20-bar MACD would confirm it — a fast exit.
example.zh: 一只股票连涨九天后，B36 下穿零轴，说明短线推力消失，比 MACD 确认早好几天，适合快速离场。

formula.en:
BIAS = (C − SMA(C, 5)) / SMA(C, 5)
DIF = BIAS − BIAS₋₁₆
DBCD = SMMA(DIF, 76)
MM = SMA(DBCD, 5)
formula.zh:
BIAS = (C − SMA(C, 5)) / SMA(C, 5)
DIF = BIAS − BIAS₋₁₆
DBCD = SMMA(DIF, 76)
MM = SMA(DBCD, 5)

principle.en: Measures whether price's stretch from its short-term average is bigger or smaller than 16 bars ago, then smooths it very heavily. The result is a slow line that flips sign rarely.
principle.zh: 比较价格偏离短期均线的程度和 16 根前相比是变大还是变小，再做非常重的平滑，得到一条很少翻转的慢线。

example.en: On a weekly index chart, DBCD stays on one side of zero for months at a time; its rare sign flips can mark a change in the long-term regime.
example.zh: 在指数周线上，DBCD 往往连续几个月停在零轴一侧，少有的几次翻转可能标志着长期格局的改变。

formula.en:
MOVE = max(|H − H₋₁|, |L − L₋₁|)
Up shift if (H+L) rose, down shift if it fell
SRDM = (avg up − avg down) / max(avg up, avg down)
ASRDM = SMMA(SRDM, 30)
formula.zh:
MOVE = max(|H − H₋₁|, |L − L₋₁|)
(H+L) 上升记为上移，下降记为下移
SRDM = (上移均值 − 下移均值) / max(上移均值, 下移均值)
ASRDM = SMMA(SRDM, 30)

principle.en: Over ten bars, how one-sided the shift of the whole trading range has been, scaled to −1 … +1. The smoothed ASRDM line is the one worth reading.
principle.zh: 最近十根 K 线里，整个价格区间向上还是向下迁移得有多一边倒，范围 −1 到 +1。真正好读的是平滑后的 ASRDM。

example.en: Because it is bounded, you can count trends across a portfolio: if 15 of your 20 holdings have ASRDM above +0.3, most of your book is trending up.
example.zh: 因为有上下限，可以用来清点组合：20 只持仓中有 15 只 ASRDM 高于 +0.3，说明大部分持仓处于上升趋势。

formula.en:
d = price rank − time rank (within N bars)
RCI = (1 − 6Σd² / (N(N² − 1))) × 100
Range −100 … +100; N = 5, 25, 50

principle.en: Checks whether closes line up in order over time. Only the ranking matters, not the size of moves, so a single freak spike or gap can't distort it.
principle.zh: 检查收盘价是否按时间顺序依次排列。只看排名、不看幅度，所以一次异常跳空或尖刺扭曲不了它。

example.en: A thin small-cap gaps 12% on one block trade and drifts back. RSI spikes and stays distorted; RCI just counts it as one more rank and barely reacts.
example.zh: 一只冷门小盘股因一笔大单跳涨 12% 后回落。RSI 剧烈跳动并持续失真，RCI 只把它当作排名多了一位，几乎不受影响。

formula.en:
EMA1 = EMA(H − L, 9)
EMA2 = EMA(EMA1, 9)
MI = Σ(EMA1 / EMA2) over 10 bars
Bulge trigger ≈ 10.8 (27 when summed over 25)
formula.zh:
EMA1 = EMA(H − L, 9)
EMA2 = EMA(EMA1, 9)
MI = 10 根内 Σ(EMA1 / EMA2)
膨胀触发 ≈ 10.8（25 根求和时为 27）

principle.en: Reversals are often preceded by daily ranges widening. The Mass Index adds up how much ranges are expanding versus normal. It says a turn may come, not which way.
principle.zh: 反转前往往先出现日内振幅扩大。梅斯线累计振幅比平常扩大了多少；它提示可能转向，但不说明方向。

example.en: After months of steady gains on narrowing ranges, daily ranges suddenly widen and MI pushes through its trigger. Big players may be selling — a top is near.
example.zh: 连涨几个月、振幅越来越窄之后，振幅突然放大，MI 冲破触发线——大资金可能在出货，顶部临近。

formula.en: VROC = (V − V₋₁₂) / V₋₁₂ × 100
formula.zh: VROC = (V − V₋₁₂) / V₋₁₂ × 100

principle.en: Today's volume compared with the volume 12 bars ago, in percent. It shows whether participation is growing, but it compares against just one old bar, so it can be noisy.
principle.zh: 今天成交量与 12 根前那一根相比变化了百分之几，反映参与度是否在增加。只和一根旧 K 线比，所以容易跳动。

example.en: A stock coiled in a 4% range for three weeks closes above the range with VROC at +180%. The breakout has real buyers behind it.
example.zh: 一只股票在 4% 区间盘整三周后收盘突破，VROC 达到 +180%，说明突破背后有真实买盘。

formula.en:
DTM = max(H − O, O − O₋₁) if O > O₋₁, else 0
DBM = max(O − L, O − O₋₁) if O < O₋₁, else 0
ADTM = (ΣDTM − ΣDBM) / max(ΣDTM, ΣDBM)   (23 bars)
ADTM_MA = SMA(ADTM, 8)
formula.zh:
DTM = O > O₋₁ 时取 max(H − O, O − O₋₁)，否则 0
DBM = O < O₋₁ 时取 max(O − L, O − O₋₁)，否则 0
ADTM = (ΣDTM − ΣDBM) / max(ΣDTM, ΣDBM)（23 根）
ADTM_MA = SMA(ADTM, 8)

principle.en: Compares buying push and selling push measured from each day's open. It captures both overnight gaps and whether the opening move was extended. Above +0.5 is hot, below −0.5 is weak.
principle.zh: 以开盘价为基准，比较买方和卖方的推力，同时反映隔夜跳空和开盘后的延续。高于 +0.5 偏热，低于 −0.5 偏弱。

example.en: Useful for A-shares, where the opening auction packs overnight news into one price. A stock up three weeks with ADTM at +0.62 that dips below its average is losing steam.
example.zh: 适合 A 股，集合竞价把隔夜消息浓缩进开盘价。一只涨了三周、ADTM 在 +0.62 的股票跌破均线，说明买气在减弱。

formula.en:
BBI = (MA3 + MA6 + MA12 + MA24) / 4
σ = StdDev(BBI, 11)
UPR = BBI + 6σ, DWN = BBI − 6σ
formula.zh:
BBI = (MA3 + MA6 + MA12 + MA24) / 4
σ = StdDev(BBI, 11)
上轨 = BBI + 6σ，下轨 = BBI − 6σ

principle.en: The BBI line with bands drawn six standard deviations of BBI itself either side. Since BBI is already smooth, the bands behave much like ordinary Bollinger Bands, only wider.
principle.zh: 在 BBI 线两侧各画 6 倍「BBI 自身标准差」的通道。BBI 本身已很平滑，所以通道表现类似普通布林带，只是更宽。

example.en: A large cap moves sideways in a 4% box for six weeks; the bands pinch to under 2.5% wide around 52. A close outside that pinch often starts the next leg.
example.zh: 一只大盘股在 4% 箱体里横了六周，通道在 52 元附近收窄到不足 2.5%；一旦收在通道外，往往开启下一段行情。

formula.en:
BBW = (UPPER − LOWER) / MID
= 4σ / SMA(C, 20)
formula.zh:
BBW = (上轨 − 下轨) / 中轨
= 4σ / SMA(C, 20)

principle.en: The width of the Bollinger Bands as a fraction of price. It turns 'the bands look tight' into a number you can compare across stocks and over time.
principle.zh: 布林带宽度占价格的比例，把「通道看起来很窄」变成一个能跨股票、跨时间比较的数字。

example.en: An index ranges 1.5% for three weeks and BBW drops to 0.021, its lowest in eight months versus a 0.055 median. Expect a big move soon, direction unknown.
example.zh: 某指数三周只波动 1.5%，BBW 降到 0.021，是八个月最低，而中位数为 0.055。大行情可能很快到来，方向未定。

formula.en:
CDP = (H₋₁ + L₋₁ + C₋₁) / 3
AH = CDP + (H₋₁ − L₋₁),  NH = 2·CDP − L₋₁
NL = 2·CDP − H₋₁,  AL = CDP − (H₋₁ − L₋₁)
formula.zh:
CDP = (H₋₁ + L₋₁ + C₋₁) / 3
最高值 AH = CDP + (H₋₁ − L₋₁)，近高值 NH = 2·CDP − L₋₁
近低值 NL = 2·CDP − H₋₁，最低值 AL = CDP − (H₋₁ − L₋₁)

principle.en: Five price levels for today, all calculated from yesterday's high, low and close. NH and NL mark a normal day's range; AH and AL are only reached on strong trend days.
principle.zh: 用昨天的最高、最低、收盘算出今天的五个价位。NH、NL 是正常日的波动范围，AH、AL 只有强趋势日才会触及。

example.en: Yesterday: high 4,120, low 4,060, close 4,092. Today's levels: NL 4,061, CDP 4,091, NH 4,121. Price dips to 4,063 and reverses — a planned buy near NL.
example.zh: 昨日高 4120、低 4060、收 4092，今日 NL 为 4061、CDP 为 4091、NH 为 4121。价格跌到 4063 后反转，正是计划中的买点。

formula.en:
ATR = SMMA(TR, 10)
STOP_LONG = LLV(LLV(L, 10) + ATR, 9)
STOP_SHORT = HHV(HHV(H, 10) − ATR, 9)
formula.zh:
ATR = SMMA(TR, 10)
多头止损 = LLV(LLV(L, 10) + ATR, 9)
空头止损 = HHV(HHV(H, 10) − ATR, 9)

principle.en: Two trailing stop lines spaced by ATR and filtered a second time so they step smoothly instead of jittering. The long stop only rises once the market has really made higher lows.
principle.zh: 两条按 ATR 设置、再经过二次过滤的跟踪止损线，平稳阶梯式移动而不乱跳。多头止损只有在真正抬高低点后才上移。

example.en: Entered at $28, a stock runs to $41 in four months. A fixed 8% trailing stop got hit twice on normal dips; the CKS long stop kept you in the whole way.
example.zh: 28 美元买入，四个月涨到 41 美元。固定 8% 跟踪止损在正常回调中被打掉两次，CKS 多头止损让你一路拿住。

formula.en:
UP = HHV(H, 20)
DOWN = LLV(L, 20)
MIDDLE = (UP + DOWN) / 2
formula.zh:
上轨 = HHV(H, 20)
下轨 = LLV(L, 20)
中轨 = (上轨 + 下轨) / 2

principle.en: The highest high and lowest low of the last N bars. No statistics involved: a close above the top line is simply a new N-bar high, the cleanest breakout trigger there is.
principle.zh: 最近 N 根 K 线的最高价和最低价。没有任何统计假设：收盘站上上轨，就是创出 N 日新高，最干净的突破信号。

example.en: A commodity sits between 88.0 and 94.5 for a month, then closes at 95.1 — a new 20-bar high. Buy on the close with a stop at the middle line, 91.25.
example.zh: 某商品一个月在 88.0–94.5 之间，随后收在 95.1，创 20 日新高。收盘买入，止损放在中轨 91.25。

formula.en:
MA = SMA(C, 10)
UPPER = MA × 1.11
LOWER = MA × 0.91
ENE = (UPPER + LOWER) / 2
formula.zh:
MA = SMA(C, 10)
上轨 = MA × 1.11
下轨 = MA × 0.91
ENE = (上轨 + 下轨) / 2

principle.en: A moving average with fixed percentage bands above and below. The width is your own assumption about how far the stock usually strays, not a measurement of volatility.
principle.zh: 在均线上下各画一条固定百分比的轨道。宽度是你自己对「股票通常偏离多远」的假设，而不是测出来的波动率。

example.en: A sleepy utility at 30.00 with MA10 at 29.80 has bands at 33.08 and 27.12. Over 18 months it touched each band a few times and turned back every time.
example.zh: 一只平稳的公用事业股报 30 元，10 日均线 29.8 元，轨道为 33.08 和 27.12。18 个月里几次触及轨道，每次都掉头回来。

formula.en:
ML = EMA(C, 20)
ATR = SMA(TR, 14)
UB = ML + 2 × ATR
LB = ML − 2 × ATR
formula.zh:
中轨 = EMA(C, 20)
ATR = SMA(TR, 14)
上轨 = 中轨 + 2 × ATR
下轨 = 中轨 − 2 × ATR

principle.en: An EMA with a channel two ATRs either side. Because ATR counts gaps and intraday swings, the channel reflects real trading risk, not just how closing prices scatter.
principle.zh: EMA 两侧各加 2 倍 ATR 的通道。ATR 包含跳空和日内波动，所以通道反映的是真实交易风险，而不只是收盘价的离散。

example.en: In a strong rally, price hugs the upper Keltner band for weeks and only pulls back to the middle line. Each pullback to the middle is a place to add, not a top.
example.zh: 强势上涨中，价格贴着肯特纳上轨走了几周，只回踩到中轨。每次回到中轨都是加仓点，而不是顶部。

formula.en:
TYP = (H + L + C) / 3, HH = HHV(H, 12), LL = LLV(L, 12)
WR = 2·TYP − LL,  MR = TYP + (HH − LL),  SR = 2·HH − LL
WS = 2·TYP − HH,  MS = TYP − (HH − LL),  SS = 2·LL − HH
formula.zh:
TYP = (H + L + C) / 3，HH = HHV(H, 12)，LL = LLV(L, 12)
弱压力 = 2·TYP − LL，中压力 = TYP + (HH − LL)，强压力 = 2·HH − LL
弱支撑 = 2·TYP − HH，中支撑 = TYP − (HH − LL)，强支撑 = 2·LL − HH

principle.en: Six support and resistance lines built from the typical price and the 12-bar high and low. They all move together, so treat them as a ladder of targets rather than separate signals.
principle.zh: 用典型价和 12 日高低点算出六条支撑压力线。它们同步移动，更适合当作一组目标价阶梯，而不是六个独立信号。

example.en: Long from 117 with weak, medium and strong resistance at 122.6, 125.2 and 127.8: sell a third at each level instead of deciding on the fly.
example.zh: 117 元做多，弱、中、强压力分别是 122.6、125.2、127.8，到一档卖三分之一，不用临场纠结。

formula.en:
PP = (prev High + prev Low + 2 × Open) / 4
R1 = 2·PP − prev Low,  S1 = 2·PP − prev High
R2 = PP + range,  S2 = PP − range
range = prev High − prev Low
formula.zh:
PP = (前期最高 + 前期最低 + 2 × 本期开盘) / 4
R1 = 2·PP − 前期最低，S1 = 2·PP − 前期最高
R2 = PP + 区间，S2 = PP − 区间
区间 = 前期最高 − 前期最低

principle.en: Horizontal levels for this period from last period's range plus this period's open, which gets double weight. They work largely because many traders watch the same numbers.
principle.zh: 用上一周期的高低点加上本周期开盘价（双倍权重）算出一组水平价位。它们有效，很大程度上因为大家都盯着同样的数字。

example.en: Last week ranged 4,180–4,265 and this week opens at 4,240: PP 4,231, S1 4,197.5. Monday dips to 4,199, forms a hammer and reverses right at S1.
example.zh: 上周区间 4180–4265，本周开 4240，算得 PP 为 4231、S1 为 4197.5。周一跌到 4199 收锤子线，正好在 S1 反转。

formula.en:
V = shares traded during the bar
Green if C ≥ C₋₁, red if C < C₋₁
Read as a ratio: V / SMA(V, n)
formula.zh:
V = 该 K 线内成交的股数
C ≥ C₋₁ 为绿，C < C₋₁ 为红
按比值看：V / SMA(V, n)

principle.en: How many shares changed hands. Price shows where the market settled; volume shows how many people had to agree to get it there.
principle.zh: 成交了多少股。价格告诉你市场停在哪里，成交量告诉你有多少人参与、共同把它推到那里。

example.en: A stock capped at $52 for eleven weeks on 1.8m shares a day closes at $54.40 on 6.2m. That 3.4× volume says real buyers took out every seller.
example.zh: 一只股票在 52 美元被压了 11 周，日均 180 万股；某天放量 620 万股收在 54.4 美元，3.4 倍的量说明真买盘吃掉了所有卖单。

formula.en:
MAVOL(n) = SMA(V, n)
Common: MAVOL5, MAVOL10, MAVOL20
V > MAVOL5 → expansion; V < MAVOL5 → contraction
formula.zh:
MAVOL(n) = SMA(V, n)
常用：MAVOL5、MAVOL10、MAVOL20
V > MAVOL5 → 放量；V < MAVOL5 → 缩量

principle.en: A moving average through the volume bars, so you can tell if today is busier or quieter than normal. When the short line rises above the long one, the whole market is getting busier.
principle.zh: 给成交量柱画一条均线，一眼看出今天比平常放量还是缩量。短期量线升到长期量线之上，说明整体交投在升温。

example.en: Add one filter to a 20-day-high breakout system: volume must be at least MAVOL20. It removes about a third of trades, mostly the quiet drifts that fail.
example.zh: 给「创 20 日新高就买」的系统加一条：成交量至少达到 MAVOL20。约三分之一交易被过滤掉，多半是那些缩量、最终失败的假突破。

formula.en:
AVGVOL(n) = SMA(V₋₁, n)   (today excluded)
Default n = 50
RVOL = V / AVGVOL
formula.zh:
AVGVOL(n) = SMA(V₋₁, n)（不含当天）
默认 n = 50
RVOL = V / AVGVOL

principle.en: A long, quarter-length average of past volume that leaves today out. It is a clean yardstick of normal trading that a single spike can't inflate.
principle.zh: 约一个季度的历史平均成交量，且不包含今天。它是一把干净的「正常成交量」标尺，不会被单日放量拉高。

example.en: Rule: never take more than 5% of average volume. A stock averaging 900k shares caps you at 45k; if the average halves, your maximum size halves too.
example.zh: 规则：仓位不超过平均成交量的 5%。日均 90 万股的股票最多买 4.5 万股；平均量减半，上限也跟着减半。

formula.en:
NVOL = sign(C − C₋₁) × V
Running sum of NVOL = OBV
formula.zh:
NVOL = sign(C − C₋₁) × V
NVOL 的累计和 = OBV

principle.en: Each bar's volume gets a plus sign on up days and a minus sign on down days. It shows which side won each day and how much trading it took.
principle.zh: 上涨日成交量记为正，下跌日记为负。它显示每天哪一方赢了，以及赢得这一天用了多少成交量。

example.en: A stock falls to its $28 base on 4.1m shares, the biggest volume of the decline, yet closes only 11 cents lower. Heavy selling was absorbed — buyers are defending.
example.zh: 一只股票跌到 28 美元平台，成交 410 万股，是这轮下跌最大量，收盘却只跌 0.11 美元。大量抛盘被吸收，买方在护盘。

formula.en:
RVOL = V / SMA(V₋₁, 14)
1.0 = average, 3.0 = three times normal
formula.zh:
RVOL = V / SMA(V₋₁, 14)
1.0 = 平均水平，3.0 = 正常的三倍

principle.en: Today's volume as a multiple of its recent normal. The units cancel, so a mega-cap and a micro-cap can be compared directly.
principle.zh: 今天成交量是近期正常水平的几倍。单位被约掉了，所以大盘股和小盘股可以直接比较。

example.en: A $32 stock that usually trades 400k shares does 1.9m by mid-morning: RVOL near 5. Something happened, even before you know the news.
example.zh: 一只 32 美元、平时日成交 40 万股的股票，上午就成交了 190 万股，量比接近 5——还没看到新闻就知道出事了。

formula.en:
VSTD = StdDev(V, 10)
Scale-free version: CV = VSTD / SMA(V, 10)
formula.zh:
VSTD = StdDev(V, 10)
无量纲版本：CV = VSTD / SMA(V, 10)

principle.en: How much volume has jumped around its 10-bar average. Low means steady daily trading; high means trading comes in bursts. It says nothing about direction.
principle.zh: 成交量围绕 10 日均量波动有多大。低表示每天交易稳定，高表示交易一阵一阵地爆发。不说明方向。

example.en: A screen for 'volume above 2× average' fires constantly on erratic stocks. Requiring volume 2.5 VSTD above the mean keeps only truly unusual spikes.
example.zh: 「成交量超过均量 2 倍」的筛选在成交忽大忽小的股票上频繁触发；改成超过均量 2.5 倍 VSTD，只留下真正异常的放量。

formula.en: VOSC = (SMA(V, 12) − SMA(V, 26)) / SMA(V, 12) × 100
formula.zh: VOSC = (SMA(V, 12) − SMA(V, 26)) / SMA(V, 12) × 100

principle.en: The gap between short and long volume averages, as a percentage. It tracks whether participation is trending up or down over weeks, not just on one day.
principle.zh: 短期与长期均量的差距，用百分比表示。它看的是几周内参与度在上升还是下降，而不是某一天。

example.en: A stock's first two rallies came with VOSC at +10 to +18. On the third leg it makes a new high with VOSC at −6: fewer buyers are carrying the trend.
example.zh: 一只股票前两段上涨时 VOSC 在 +10 到 +18，第三段创新高时 VOSC 却是 −6——支撑趋势的买家越来越少。

formula.en:
AMOUNT = Σ(price × size) ≈ C × V
MAAMT = SMA(AMOUNT, 20)
formula.zh:
成交额 = Σ(成交价 × 成交量) ≈ C × V
MAAMT = SMA(成交额, 20)

principle.en: The money that changed hands, not the number of shares. Money is what investors actually allocate, and it isn't changed by stock splits, so it compares fairly across stocks.
principle.zh: 成交的金额，而不是股数。资金才是投资者真正投入的东西，也不受拆股影响，所以能在不同股票间公平比较。

example.en: One million shares of a ¥6 stock is ¥6m; of a ¥600 stock it is ¥600m. Same share count, a hundred times the money.
example.zh: 100 万股 6 元的股票是 600 万元，100 万股 600 元的股票是 6 亿元。股数相同，资金差了一百倍。

formula.en:
TOR = V / free-float shares × 100
MATOR = SMA(TOR, 5)
formula.zh:
换手率 = V / 流通股本 × 100
MATOR = SMA(换手率, 5)

principle.en: The percentage of a company's tradable shares that changed hands. It puts every stock on the same attention scale: under 1% a day is dormant, above 15% is a frenzy.
principle.zh: 成交量占流通股的百分比，让所有股票的热度用同一把尺子衡量：日换手低于 1% 是冷门，超过 15% 是过热。

example.en: A stock idles at 0.8% daily turnover for four months, then trades 6–9% for three days as it breaks out. About a quarter of the float changed hands — new owners arrived.
example.zh: 一只股票四个月日换手只有 0.8%，突破时连续三天换手 6–9%，约四分之一的流通盘易手——新主力进场了。

formula.en:
VVOL = V so far × (T + 3) / (t + 3)
T = minutes in the session, t = minutes elapsed
On a closed bar, VVOL = V
formula.zh:
虚拟量 = 当前累计量 × (T + 3) / (t + 3)
T = 全天交易分钟数，t = 已过分钟数
已收盘 K 线上，虚拟量 = V

principle.en: A live estimate of today's full volume, extrapolated from the pace so far. Once the bar closes it simply equals actual volume.
principle.zh: 按目前成交节奏推算今天全天成交量的实时估计。K 线收盘后，它就等于实际成交量。

example.en: At 10:15 a stock breaks a three-month high with 620k shares traded. Projected: 620k × 243 / 108 ≈ 1.4m, matching the 10-day average — so far, not a heavy breakout.
example.zh: 10:15 一只股票突破三个月高点，已成交 62 万股，推算全天 62 万 × 243 / 108 ≈ 140 万，只和 10 日均量持平，目前算不上放量突破。

formula.en:
P/E = price / earnings per share
Trailing: last four quarters of EPS
Forward: next twelve months estimated EPS
Earnings yield = 1 / P/E
formula.zh:
市盈率 = 股价 / 每股收益
滚动市盈率：最近四个季度的每股收益
预期市盈率：未来十二个月的预测每股收益
盈利收益率 = 1 / 市盈率

principle.en: How many years of current earnings you pay for one share. On a chart it is most useful to see where today's price sits within the range investors have paid for this company before.
principle.zh: 买一股相当于付了多少年的当前利润。在图上，最有用的是看今天的价格处在这家公司历史估值区间的什么位置。

example.en: A quality company has traded between 18× and 32× earnings for six years. A breakout at 34× is technically real, but you're paying more than anyone has before.
example.zh: 一家优质公司六年来市盈率在 18 到 32 倍之间。在 34 倍时出现突破，技术上成立，但你付的价格比以往任何时候都贵。

formula.en:
VA = +V if C > C₋₁, −V if C < C₋₁, 0 otherwise
OBV = running sum of VA
OBVMA = SMA(OBV, 30)
formula.zh:
VA = C > C₋₁ 时为 +V，C < C₋₁ 时为 −V，否则为 0
OBV = VA 的累计和
OBVMA = SMA(OBV, 30)

principle.en: Adds volume on up days and subtracts it on down days, keeping a running total. The level itself is arbitrary; its slope shows which side volume has been voting for.
principle.zh: 上涨日加上成交量，下跌日减去成交量，持续累计。数值本身没有意义，斜率显示成交量一直在支持哪一方。

example.en: A stock chops between $18 and $19.50 for eleven weeks while OBV climbs to a new high. Buyers are accumulating quietly — a breakout often follows.
example.zh: 一只股票在 18–19.5 美元震荡了 11 周，OBV 却持续攀升创新高。资金在悄悄吸筹，随后往往会向上突破。

formula.en:
TP = (H + L + C) / 3
VWAP = Σ(TP × V) / ΣV   (summed from the anchor bar)
formula.zh:
TP =（最高 + 最低 + 收盘）/ 3
VWAP = Σ(TP × V) / ΣV （从锚点起累计）

principle.en: The average price actually paid per share since the anchor, so heavy-volume bars count more. Big trading desks are judged against it, which is why price often bounces off it.
principle.zh: 自锚点以来每股的平均成交价，成交越大的K线权重越高。机构交易台以它为考核基准，所以价格常在它附近获得支撑或遇到压力。

example.en: A stock gaps down, then climbs back above VWAP at $46.20 and holds. Buyers have taken control for the day; a pullback that holds $46.20 is a typical entry.
example.zh: 某股低开后重新站上46.20元的VWAP并守住，说明当天买方占了上风；回踩不破46.20元就是常见的买点。

formula.en:
VWAP = Σ(TP × V) / ΣV
σ = StdDev(TP, 20)
Upper k = VWAP + k·σ,  Lower k = VWAP − k·σ   (k = 1, 2)
formula.zh:
VWAP = Σ(TP × V) / ΣV
σ = TP 的20周期标准差
上轨k = VWAP + k·σ，下轨k = VWAP − k·σ（k = 1, 2）

principle.en: Bollinger-style bands drawn around VWAP instead of a moving average. The bands show how far price has stretched from what traders actually paid, measured in standard deviations.
principle.zh: 类似布林带，但中轨换成VWAP。上下轨表示价格偏离市场平均成本有多远，以标准差为单位。

example.en: On a range day the index twice pushes to the +2σ band at 5,204 and closes back inside on falling volume. Fading that second failure back toward VWAP is the classic trade.
example.zh: 震荡日里指数两次冲到+2σ上轨5204点，又缩量收回轨内；第二次失败时做空、目标回到VWAP，是典型用法。

formula.en:
raw = (C − C₋₁) × V
EFI = EMA(raw, n)   (n = 13 trend, n = 2 timing)
formula.zh:
原始值 =（收盘 − 昨收）× 成交量
EFI = EMA(原始值, n)（n = 13 看趋势，n = 2 找时机）

principle.en: Price change times volume: how far price moved and how many shares pushed it. Above zero means buyers have the force; below zero, sellers.
principle.zh: 价格涨跌幅乘以成交量，同时衡量“走了多远”和“多少人在推”。在零轴上方说明买方有力，下方则是卖方占优。

example.en: A stock in an uptrend pulls back on light volume. EFI(2) dips deeply negative, then turns up as price stops falling — a common buy-the-dip signal.
example.zh: 上升趋势中的股票缩量回调，EFI(2)跌到很深的负值后拐头向上、价格止跌，这是常见的回调买入信号。

name.zh: 克林格成交量摆动指标

formula.en:
VF = +V if TP ≥ TP₋₁, else −V
KVO = EMA(VF, 34) − EMA(VF, 55)
Signal = EMA(KVO, 13)
formula.zh:
量力VF = TP ≥ 前一TP 时取 +V，否则取 −V
KVO = EMA(VF, 34) − EMA(VF, 55)
信号线 = EMA(KVO, 13)

principle.en: Basically MACD applied to volume that is signed up or down by the bar's direction. It tracks whether buying or selling volume is gaining momentum.
principle.zh: 相当于把MACD用在“带方向的成交量”上：上涨K线的量记正，下跌记负，看买卖量能哪一方在加速。

example.en: An index makes a new low 4% below the last one, but KVO's dip is only half as deep. Less selling volume drove the new low, hinting the decline is tiring.
example.zh: 指数创出比前低再低4%的新低，但KVO的低点只有上次一半深，说明新低的卖压更小，下跌可能接近尾声。

formula.en: WVAD = (C − O) / (H − L) × V
formula.zh: WVAD =（收盘 − 开盘）/（最高 − 最低）× 成交量

principle.en: Measures how decisively each bar was won: the candle body as a share of its range, scaled by volume. A strong close on big volume scores high; an indecisive bar scores near zero.
principle.zh: 衡量每根K线谁赢得更彻底：实体占振幅的比例乘以成交量。放量收在高位得分高，十字星则接近零。

example.en: During a quiet base, seven sessions open weak, close strong and post large positive WVAD readings. That cluster suggests someone is quietly buying.
example.zh: 横盘整理期间有七天都是低开高走、WVAD大幅为正，这种扎堆出现的信号暗示有人在悄悄吸筹。

formula.en:
MID = previous bar's (H + L + C) / 3
CR = Σ max(0, H − MID) / Σ max(0, MID − L) × 100   (n = 26)
formula.zh:
中间价MID = 前一根K线的（最高 + 最低 + 收盘）/ 3
CR = Σ max(0, 最高 − MID) / Σ max(0, MID − 最低) × 100（n = 26）

principle.en: Compares how far price reached above the previous bar's midpoint with how far it reached below, over 26 bars. Above 100 means buyers have been pushing harder than sellers.
principle.zh: 比较26根K线里价格高于前一根中间价的幅度和低于它的幅度。高于100说明买方推得比卖方更远。

example.en: After a sharp two-week sell-off, CR sits at 38, an 18-month low. Almost every bar has been probing down, a deeply depressed reading that often precedes a rebound.
example.zh: 急跌两周后CR只有38，创18个月新低，几乎每天都在向下试探。这种极度低迷的读数常出现在反弹之前。

formula.en:
AR = Σ(H − O) / Σ(O − L) × 100
BR = Σ max(0, H − C₋₁) / Σ max(0, C₋₁ − L) × 100   (n = 26)
formula.zh:
AR = Σ(最高 − 开盘) / Σ(开盘 − 最低) × 100
BR = Σ max(0, 最高 − 昨收) / Σ max(0, 昨收 − 最低) × 100（n = 26）

principle.en: AR measures intraday buying energy from the open; BR measures it from yesterday's close, so it also includes the overnight gap. The gap between the two shows how much the crowd is chasing.
principle.zh: AR以开盘价为基准，衡量盘中人气；BR以昨收为基准，把隔夜跳空也算进去。两者的差距反映大家追高的程度。

example.en: Late in a speculative run, BR soars from 180 to 430 while AR stays near 195. Every day gaps up and gets sold, a classic sign of a blow-off top.
example.zh: 投机行情末段，BR从180飙到430，AR却只有195左右：天天高开后被卖，是典型的冲顶信号。

formula.en:
PSY = (up closes in last 12 bars) / 12 × 100
PSYMA = SMA(PSY, 6)
formula.zh:
PSY = 最近12根中收涨的根数 / 12 × 100
PSYMA = SMA(PSY, 6)

principle.en: Simply the percentage of recent days that closed up. It ignores how big the moves were, assuming crowd mood follows how often the market has gone up.
principle.zh: 就是最近收涨天数的占比，不管涨跌幅多大。思路是：人群情绪取决于市场最近“涨了几次”。

example.en: An index in a four-month range rallies to the top with 11 up days out of 12 (PSY 91.7). Such streaks are rare and the index often slips back.
example.zh: 震荡四个月的指数涨到区间上沿，12天里涨了11天（PSY 91.7）。这种连涨很少见，之后往往会回落。

formula.en:
VR = 100 × (2·Up volume + Flat volume) / (2·Down volume + Flat volume)   (n = 26)
VRMA = SMA(VR, 6)
formula.zh:
VR = 100 ×（2·上涨日成交量 + 平盘日成交量）/（2·下跌日成交量 + 平盘日成交量）（n = 26）
VRMA = SMA(VR, 6)

principle.en: Volume on up days divided by volume on down days over 26 days. VR 150 means 50% more volume traded on up days than on down days.
principle.zh: 26天内上涨日成交量除以下跌日成交量。VR为150表示上涨日的成交量比下跌日多50%。

example.en: A stock down 45% makes a lower low, yet VR rises from 44 to 71 because the second drop came on half the volume. Selling is drying up.
example.zh: 某股累计跌45%后再创新低，但VR从44升到71，因为第二次下跌只有一半的量，说明抛压正在枯竭。

formula.en:
A = turnover per bar ≈ TP × V
CYC(k) = EMA(A, k) / EMA(V, k)   (k = 5, 13, 34)
CYC∞ updates by the daily turnover rate of the float
formula.zh:
成交额A ≈ TP × V
CYC(k) = EMA(A, k) / EMA(V, k)（k = 5, 13, 34）
CYC∞ 按流通股每日换手率逐步更新

principle.en: Lines of average cost rather than average price: what buyers actually paid over the last k bars. Price above the lines means recent holders are in profit; below means they are trapped.
principle.zh: 画的是平均成本而不是平均价格，即最近k根K线买家实际付出的均价。价格在线上方说明近期持有者赚钱，下方则被套。

example.en: A stock falls from 32 to 19, then bases for five months while CYC∞ grinds down from 27 to 21.4. High-cost holders have been replaced, so a breakout above it faces little supply.
example.zh: 某股从32元跌到19元后横盘五个月，CYC∞从27降到21.4，高成本筹码已换手，之后突破时上方抛压很小。

formula.en:
side = +1 buyer-initiated, −1 seller-initiated
Inflow = Σ side × price × size   (all order sizes)
Cumulative = running sum of daily inflow
formula.zh:
方向 = 主动买入 +1，主动卖出 −1
净流入 = Σ 方向 × 价格 × 数量（全部单量档位）
累计值 = 每日净流入的累加

principle.en: Buyer-initiated minus seller-initiated money traded. It shows which side was more impatient, not real money entering, since every share bought is also sold.
principle.zh: 主动买入金额减去主动卖出金额。它反映哪一方更急，而不是真有钱“流进来”——每笔买入都对应一笔卖出。

example.en: A stock sits in a 3% box for five weeks while the cumulative inflow line climbs steadily. Someone keeps lifting offers, which often precedes an upside breakout.
example.zh: 某股五周都在3%的箱体里横盘，累计净流入却稳步上升，说明有人一直在主动买，常是向上突破的前兆。

formula.en:
XL inflow = Σ side × price × size   (only prints ≥ about ¥1m)
XL% = XL inflow / total turnover
formula.zh:
特大单净流入 = Σ 方向 × 价格 × 数量（仅限约100万元以上的成交）
占比 = 特大单净流入 / 当日总成交额

principle.en: Net aggressive buying in only the very largest trades, used as a hint of institutional activity. It is most useful when it disagrees with small-order flow.
principle.zh: 只统计最大一档成交的主动买卖差，被视作机构动向的线索。它和小单资金方向相反时最有参考价值。

example.en: A stock drops 12% in five days. Small orders sell every day while extra-large orders net buy ¥450m. Retail is capitulating and a big player is absorbing it.
example.zh: 某股五天跌12%，小单天天净卖出，特大单却累计净买入4.5亿元：散户在割肉，大资金在承接。

formula.en: L inflow = Σ side × price × size   (prints of about ¥200k–¥1m)
formula.zh: 大单净流入 = Σ 方向 × 价格 × 数量（单笔约20万至100万元）

principle.en: Net aggressive buying in the size band just below the biggest trades. Institutions slice big orders into pieces of about this size, so it is often a truer read of fund activity than extra-large orders.
principle.zh: 统计仅次于特大单那一档的主动买卖差。机构常把大单拆成这种尺寸分批成交，所以它往往比特大单更能反映机构动向。

example.en: A stock shows one huge extra-large buy day. If large-order inflow then stays positive for eight of ten sessions, it is a real buying campaign, not a one-off block.
example.zh: 某股某天出现巨额特大单买入。如果之后十天里有八天大单都是净流入，那才是持续建仓，而不是一次性的大宗交易。

formula.en: M inflow = Σ side × price × size   (prints of about ¥40k–¥200k)
formula.zh: 中单净流入 = Σ 方向 × 价格 × 数量（单笔约4万至20万元）

principle.en: Net aggressive buying in the middle size band. It mixes larger retail, small funds and sliced algorithm orders, so on its own it says little.
principle.zh: 中间档位的主动买卖差。这里混着大户、小基金和算法拆单，成分说不清，单独看意义不大。

example.en: After a 30% run, extra-large, large and medium orders all net sell for two weeks while only small orders buy. Selling is broad, not just one group.
example.zh: 某股大涨30%后两周，特大单、大单、中单都在净卖出，只有小单在买，说明卖出是普遍行为，并非某一类人。

formula.en: S inflow = Σ side × price × size   (prints under about ¥40k)
formula.zh: 小单净流入 = Σ 方向 × 价格 × 数量（单笔约4万元以下）

principle.en: Net aggressive buying in the smallest trades, traditionally read as the retail crowd. Retail tends to chase late, so it is used as a contrarian signal.
principle.zh: 最小档位的主动买卖差，传统上代表散户。散户往往追得晚，所以常被当作反向指标。

example.en: A small-cap is up 45% in seven weeks. Over ten days small orders net buy ¥190m while extra-large orders net sell ¥260m. Shares are passing from early to late buyers — a likely top.
example.zh: 某小盘股七周涨45%，近十天小单净买1.9亿元、特大单净卖2.6亿元，筹码从先知先觉者流向后知后觉者，很可能见顶。

formula.en:
OI = contracts still open after settlement (longs = shorts)
Price ↑ OI ↑ new longs · Price ↑ OI ↓ short covering
Price ↓ OI ↑ new shorts · Price ↓ OI ↓ long liquidation
formula.zh:
持仓量 = 结算后仍未平仓的合约数（多头 = 空头）
价涨仓增：新多入场 · 价涨仓减：空头回补
价跌仓增：新空入场 · 价跌仓减：多头离场

principle.en: How many futures contracts are still open, not how many traded. It only rises when new money commits on both sides, so it tells you whether a move is backed by fresh positions.
principle.zh: 仍未平仓的期货合约数量，而不是成交了多少。只有多空双方都有新资金进场时它才会增加，所以能看出行情是否有新仓位支撑。

example.en: A commodity rises 9% in three weeks while open interest falls from 340k to 265k lots. The rally is shorts buying back, and it fades once they are done.
example.zh: 某商品三周涨9%，持仓却从34万手降到26.5万手。这波上涨是空头回补，回补结束后行情就容易熄火。

formula.en:
ΔOI = OI today − OI yesterday
> 0 positions opened, < 0 positions closed
formula.zh:
日增仓 = 今日持仓量 − 昨日持仓量
大于0为增仓，小于0为减仓

principle.en: The daily change in open interest. Paired with the day's price move, it tells you whether money committed or withdrew today and which side did it.
principle.zh: 持仓量的每日变化。结合当天涨跌，就能判断今天是资金进场还是离场、是多方还是空方在动。

example.en: A sideways contract suddenly adds 18k, 23k and 15k lots on three straight up days. Someone is building a long position with conviction.
example.zh: 某合约横盘一个月后，连续三天上涨分别增仓1.8万、2.3万、1.5万手，说明有人在坚决建立多头仓位。

formula.en: Options OI = Σ (call OI + put OI) over all strikes and expiries
formula.zh: 期权持仓量 = Σ（看涨持仓 + 看跌持仓），覆盖所有行权价和到期日

principle.en: Total options contracts still open on a stock. It shows how much hedging and speculation has piled up; big clusters at a few strikes can pin price near expiry.
principle.zh: 某标的所有未平仓的期权合约总数，反映堆积了多少对冲和投机仓位。若集中在少数行权价，临近到期时价格容易被“钉住”。

example.en: Huge open interest sits at the ¥100 and ¥110 strikes with the stock at ¥104. Dealer hedging tends to keep it between those strikes until expiry.
example.zh: 股价104元，期权持仓大量集中在100元和110元两个行权价，做市商的对冲操作往往会把股价困在这两者之间直到到期。

formula.en:
Options volume = Σ (call vol + put vol) traded today
Relative volume = today / 20-day average
formula.zh:
期权成交量 = 当日 Σ（看涨成交 + 看跌成交）
相对成交量 = 当日 / 20日均值

principle.en: How many option contracts traded today. Leverage makes options the quickest way to bet, so unusual options activity often shows up before the stock moves.
principle.zh: 当天期权成交了多少张。期权有杠杆，是下注最快的方式，所以异常的期权成交常常领先于股价变动。

example.en: A mid-cap that usually trades 4,000 contracts suddenly trades 31,000 while the stock barely moves. Two days later it announces a deal.
example.zh: 一只平时日成交4000张期权的中盘股突然成交3.1万张，股价却几乎没动；两天后公司宣布了一项交易。

formula.en: OI PCR = Σ put open interest / Σ call open interest
formula.zh: 持仓PCR = Σ 看跌期权持仓 / Σ 看涨期权持仓

principle.en: Open puts divided by open calls. It shows how defensive the accumulated options book is. Compare it to its own history; each stock has a different normal level.
principle.zh: 未平仓看跌期权除以看涨期权，反映累积仓位有多防御。要和它自身历史比较，每个标的的“正常值”都不一样。

example.en: After a 14% fall, an index's OI put/call ratio rises from 1.15 to 1.62, a two-year high. Hedging is crowded, so a sharp short-covering bounce becomes more likely.
example.zh: 指数下跌14%后，持仓PCR从1.15升到1.62，创两年新高。对冲已经很拥挤，出现急速反弹的可能性变大。

formula.en:
Volume PCR = Σ put volume / Σ call volume   (today)
Smoothed = SMA(PCR, 5 or 10)
formula.zh:
成交PCR = 当日 Σ 看跌成交量 / Σ 看涨成交量
平滑值 = PCR 的5日或10日均线

principle.en: Puts traded divided by calls traded today, a fast fear-and-greed gauge. It is read as a contrarian signal: extreme put buying often marks panic near a low.
principle.zh: 当天看跌期权成交除以看涨期权成交，是反应很快的恐慌贪婪指标。通常反向解读：极端买入看跌期权常出现在恐慌低点附近。

example.en: An index falls 11% in three weeks and the 10-day PCR jumps from 0.85 to 1.35, a two-year high. Fear is crowded, and a rebound often follows.
example.zh: 指数三周跌11%，10日均PCR从0.85升到1.35，创两年新高。恐慌情绪拥挤，随后常出现反弹。

formula.en:
ADD = advancers − decliners   (S&P 500 members)
A/D line = cumulative sum of ADD
formula.zh:
ADD = 上涨家数 − 下跌家数（标普500成分股）
腾落线 = ADD 的累计和

principle.en: How many S&P 500 stocks rose minus how many fell. Each stock gets one vote regardless of size, so it shows whether a move is broad or carried by a few giants.
principle.zh: 标普500里上涨家数减下跌家数。不论市值大小每只一票，可以看出行情是普涨还是靠少数巨头撑着。

example.en: With the index 14% off its high, three straight days print +415, +388 and +432. Over 85% of stocks rising together is a breadth thrust that often starts a new rally.
example.zh: 指数距高点跌14%后，连续三天读数为+415、+388、+432，超过85%的股票同时上涨，这种宽度推力常开启新一轮上涨。

name.zh: 涨跌家数差（纳斯达克综合指数）

formula.en:
ADD = advancers − decliners   (all NASDAQ listings)
Normalised = ADD / (advancers + decliners)
formula.zh:
ADD = 上涨家数 − 下跌家数（全部纳斯达克上市公司）
标准化 = ADD /（上涨家数 + 下跌家数）

principle.en: Net advancers across about 3,300 NASDAQ listings. A few mega-caps drive the index while thousands of small names drive this count, so the two often diverge.
principle.zh: 约3300家纳斯达克公司的涨跌家数差。指数由少数巨头决定，这个数字却由成千上万的小公司决定，所以两者常常背离。

example.en: In 2021 the index kept making highs into November, but the A/D spread had been mostly negative since February. The typical stock was already falling — a warning ahead of the top.
example.zh: 2021年指数一路新高到11月，但涨跌家数差从2月起就大多为负，普通股票早已在下跌，这是见顶前的预警。

name.zh: 涨跌家数差（道琼斯工业平均指数）

formula.en: ADD = advancers − decliners   (30 Dow members, range −30 to +30)
formula.zh: ADD = 上涨家数 − 下跌家数（道指30只成分股，范围 −30 至 +30）

principle.en: Net advancers among just 30 Dow stocks. With so few names it reveals little breadth; it mainly helps explain moves, since the Dow is weighted by share price.
principle.zh: 道指30只成分股的涨跌家数差。样本太少，很难反映市场宽度；因为道指按股价加权，它主要用来拆解指数涨跌。

example.en: The Dow falls 220 points but 24 of 30 stocks rose. The six losers must include the highest-priced names, so a couple of expensive stocks caused the drop.
example.zh: 道指跌220点，但30只里有24只上涨。那6只下跌的必然包括股价最高的几只，说明是少数高价股拖累了指数。

formula.en: ADD = advancers − decliners   (about 82 HSI members)
formula.zh: ADD = 上涨家数 − 下跌家数（恒指约82只成分股）

principle.en: Net advancers in the Hang Seng. The index is two blocs, old-economy banks and property versus China internet, which often move in opposite directions; this count shows whether both joined in.
principle.zh: 恒指成分股的涨跌家数差。恒指其实是两大板块——银行地产等旧经济和中概互联网，常反向走；这个数字能看出两边是否一起动。

example.en: A stimulus headline lifts the HSI 1.8%, but the spread is only +6. Only the China-internet names rallied, and such one-sided moves are often given back.
example.zh: 一条刺激政策消息让恒指涨1.8%，涨跌家数差却只有+6。只有互联网股在涨，这种单边行情常会回吐。

name.zh: 涨跌家数差（恒生科技指数）

formula.en: ADD = advancers − decliners   (30 members, range −30 to +30)
formula.zh: ADD = 上涨家数 − 下跌家数（30只成分股，范围 −30 至 +30）

principle.en: Net advancers among 30 China-tech names that all react to the same news, so readings are usually near ±26. Only the rare narrow day is informative.
principle.zh: 30只中概科技股的涨跌家数差。它们受同一类消息驱动，读数通常接近±26，只有少见的“窄幅”日子才有信息量。

example.en: HSTECH gaps up 3.2% but the spread is only +8. A few heavyweights carried the gap while 11 names fell, so fading it is the classic trade.
example.zh: 恒生科技指数高开3.2%，涨跌家数差却只有+8，靠几只权重股撑着、另有11只在跌，此时逢高做空是经典做法。

name.zh: 涨跌比率（纳斯达克综合指数）

formula.en: ADR = advancers / decliners   (all NASDAQ listings)
formula.zh: ADR = 上涨家数 / 下跌家数（全部纳斯达克上市公司）

principle.en: Advancers divided by decliners. As a ratio it is unaffected by how many companies are listed, so today's reading can be compared with any past year.
principle.zh: 上涨家数除以下跌家数。比率不受上市公司数量变化影响，所以今天的读数可以和任何年份直接比较。

example.en: In a washout the ratio prints 0.13: about 350 stocks up against 2,700 down. Readings that low are rare and tend to cluster near major lows.
example.zh: 恐慌杀跌日比率只有0.13，约350家上涨、2700家下跌。这么低的读数很少见，往往出现在重要低点附近。

name.zh: 涨跌比率（道琼斯工业平均指数）

formula.en: ADR = advancers / decliners   (30 Dow members)
formula.zh: ADR = 上涨家数 / 下跌家数（道指30只成分股）

principle.en: Advancers over decliners among only 30 stocks. The denominator is tiny, so the ratio jumps around and is undefined when nothing falls; it adds little beyond the spread.
principle.zh: 只有30只股票的涨跌比。分母太小，数值跳动剧烈，全涨时甚至无法计算，比涨跌家数差多不了什么信息。

example.en: The ratio reads 0.5 (10 up, 20 down) yet the Dow rises. Only the highest-priced members can outweigh a 2-to-1 majority, so a few expensive stocks drove the day.
example.zh: 比率0.5（10涨20跌）道指却上涨，只有股价最高的几只才能压过二比一的多数，说明是少数高价股撑起了指数。

formula.en: ADR = advancers / decliners   (about 82 HSI members, unchanged excluded)
formula.zh: ADR = 上涨家数 / 下跌家数（恒指约82只成分股，平盘不计）

principle.en: Advancers over decliners in the Hang Seng. The index grew from 50 to 82 members in 2020–2023, and only a ratio stays comparable across that change.
principle.zh: 恒指成分股的涨跌比。恒指在2020至2023年间从50只扩到82只，只有比率能跨越这次扩容保持可比。

example.en: To compare participation in the 2024 rally with 2018, the spread fails because the member count changed. A ratio of 3.0 means the same 3-to-1 split in both years.
example.zh: 想比较2024年和2018年反弹的参与度，涨跌家数差因成分股数量变了而失效；比率3.0在两个年份都代表三比一。

name.zh: 涨跌比率（恒生科技指数）

formula.en: ADR = advancers / decliners   (30 members)
formula.zh: ADR = 上涨家数 / 下跌家数（30只成分股）
