principle.en: Advancers over decliners among 30 China-tech names that move together. The ratio sits at extremes most days; only a middling reading carries real news.
principle.zh: 30只同涨同跌的中概科技股的涨跌比，大多数日子都处在极端值，只有居中的读数才有真正的信息。

example.en: Day one gaps up 4% with a ratio of 4.0. If day two adds just 0.5% and the ratio drops near 1, Hong Kong is not endorsing the overnight rally.
example.zh: 第一天高开4%、比率4.0；第二天只涨0.5%、比率回落到1左右，说明港股并不认可隔夜的上涨。

formula.en:
DIF = advancers − decliners   (S&P 500)
MCL = EMA(DIF, 19) − EMA(DIF, 39)
Summation Index = Σ MCL
formula.zh:
DIF = 上涨家数 − 下跌家数（标普500）
MCL = EMA(DIF, 19) − EMA(DIF, 39)
累计指数 = Σ MCL

principle.en: MACD applied to market breadth instead of price. It shows whether participation is speeding up or fading, which is a different question from whether the index is rising.
principle.zh: 把MACD用在市场宽度而不是价格上，看参与上涨的股票是在增加还是减少，这和指数涨不涨是两回事。

example.en: With the S&P 15% off its high, the oscillator swings from −90 to +85 in nine days and stays positive for three weeks. Such breadth thrusts often mark a durable low.
example.zh: 标普距高点跌15%时，振荡器九天内从−90升到+85并在零上维持三周，这种宽度推力常标志着可靠的底部。

name.zh: 标普 500 成分股站上 200 日均线占比

formula.en: % = (members with Close > SMA(Close, 200)) / 500 × 100
formula.zh: 占比 = 收盘价高于200日均线的成分股数 / 500 × 100

principle.en: The share of S&P 500 stocks above their own 200-day average — a headcount of stocks still in uptrends. It shows what the typical company is doing, not just the giants.
principle.zh: 标普500里站上自身200日均线的股票占比，相当于数一数还有多少股票处于上升趋势，反映普通公司而非巨头的状况。

example.en: The index rises 6% in six months while this line slides from 76 to 44. Most stocks are quietly weakening behind a few mega-caps, a reason to cut risk.
example.zh: 指数半年涨6%，这条线却从76降到44，大部分股票在少数巨头身后悄悄走弱，是降低仓位的理由。

name.zh: 纳斯达克 100 成分股站上 200 日均线占比

formula.en: % = (members with Close > SMA(Close, 200)) / 100 × 100
formula.zh: 占比 = 收盘价高于200日均线的成分股数 / 100 × 100

principle.en: How many of the 100 Nasdaq 100 stocks are above their 200-day line. The index is very top-heavy, so the gap between this count and the index is the key signal.
principle.zh: 纳斯达克100中站上200日均线的股票数。该指数极度头重脚轻，这个数字和指数走势之间的差距才是关键信号。

example.en: The index is flat for a quarter but the reading drops from 68 to 41. Two big winners are holding it up while most names roll over.
example.zh: 指数一个季度横盘，读数却从68降到41，说明两只大票撑住了指数，其余大部分股票在走弱。

name.en: % of NASDAQ Composite Stocks Above 200-Day MA
name.zh: 纳斯达克综合指数成分股站上 200 日均线占比

formula.en: % = (listings with Close > SMA(Close, 200)) / about 3,000 × 100
formula.zh: 占比 = 收盘价高于200日均线的公司数 / 约3000 × 100

principle.en: The 200-day headcount across about 3,000 NASDAQ listings, mostly small and unprofitable. Its normal level is well below 50, so compare it with its own history.
principle.zh: 约3000家纳斯达克公司的200日均线统计，其中多数是小型、未盈利公司。正常水平远低于50，要和自身历史比较。

example.en: The Composite gains 12% in two quarters while this line falls from 48 to 26. Big names soak up the money and small caps starve — a sign of tight liquidity.
example.zh: 综合指数两个季度涨12%，这条线却从48跌到26：资金都涌向大公司，小公司融不到钱，说明流动性在收紧。

name.zh: 道琼斯工业指数成分股站上 200 日均线占比

formula.en: % = (members with Close > SMA(Close, 200)) / 30 × 100
formula.zh: 占比 = 收盘价高于200日均线的成分股数 / 30 × 100

principle.en: The same headcount for only 30 blue chips, so each stock moves the reading by 3.33 points. It measures agreement inside one basket, not the whole market.
principle.zh: 同样的统计只用于30只蓝筹股，每只股票就占3.33个百分点。它衡量的是一个小篮子内部的一致性，而非整个市场。

example.en: S&P breadth recovers from 22 to 61. If the Dow count goes from 6 to 23 stocks at the same time, the recovery has reached old-economy sectors and looks real.
example.zh: 标普宽度从22回升到61，同时道指站上均线的股票从6只增到23只，说明复苏已扩散到传统行业，比较可信。

name.en: % of Semiconductor Index Stocks Above 200-Day MA
name.zh: 费城半导体指数成分股站上 200 日均线占比

formula.en: % = (members with Close > SMA(Close, 200)) / 30 × 100
formula.zh: 占比 = 收盘价高于200日均线的成分股数 / 30 × 100

principle.en: How many of 30 chip stocks are above their 200-day line. They share one industry cycle, so it flips between high and low and reads like a chip-cycle gauge.
principle.zh: 30只芯片股中站上200日均线的数量。它们同处一个行业周期，读数常在高低之间切换，更像芯片周期的仪表盘。

example.en: After a 40% fall, the line sits under 15 for four months, then climbs to 55 in six weeks as one chip group after another recovers. The downturn is likely over.
example.zh: 芯片指数跌40%后，这条线在15以下停留四个月，随后六周内随各细分板块陆续修复升到55，下行周期很可能已结束。

name.zh: 日经 225 成分股站上 200 日均线占比

formula.en: % = (members with Close > SMA(Close, 200)) / 225 × 100
formula.zh: 占比 = 收盘价高于200日均线的成分股数 / 225 × 100

principle.en: The Nikkei is weighted by share price, so a few high-priced stocks dominate it. This equal-weighted headcount shows what Japanese stocks are really doing.
principle.zh: 日经指数按股价加权，少数高价股主导指数。这个等权的统计更能反映日本股票的真实状况。

example.en: The Nikkei gains 9% as the yen weakens. If the line rises from 58 to 71, domestic stocks joined in; if it falls to 46, only a few exporters drove the gain.
example.zh: 日元走弱时日经涨9%：若这条线从58升到71，说明内需股也参与；若降到46，则只是几只出口股在拉。

name.en: % of Hang Seng Stocks Above 200-Day MA
name.zh: 恒生指数成分股站上 200 日均线占比

formula.en: % = (members with Close > SMA(Close, 200)) / about 80 × 100
formula.zh: 占比 = 收盘价高于200日均线的成分股数 / 约80 × 100

principle.en: The share of Hang Seng stocks above their 200-day line. Hong Kong is policy-driven, so the line can stay below 20 for a year, then jump to 80 on one policy shift.
principle.zh: 恒指成分股站上200日均线的占比。港股受政策驱动，这条线可能一年都在20以下，一次政策转向就跳到80。

example.en: The index rallies 18% off a low but the line only moves from 8 to 12. A few heavyweights did all the work, and such rallies have usually retraced.
example.zh: 恒指从低点反弹18%，这条线却只从8升到12，全靠几只权重股拉动，这类反弹历史上大多会回吐。

name.en: % of Hang Seng TECH Stocks Above 200-Day MA
name.zh: 恒生科技指数成分股站上 200 日均线占比

formula.en: % = (members with Close > SMA(Close, 200)) / 30 × 100
formula.zh: 占比 = 收盘价高于200日均线的成分股数 / 30 × 100

principle.en: How many of 30 China-tech stocks are above their 200-day line. They share one regulator and one funding channel, so it mostly echoes the index with a lag.
principle.zh: 30只中概科技股中站上200日均线的数量。它们受同一监管、同一资金渠道影响，多数时候只是滞后地复述指数。

example.en: The index is up 25% but the line only climbs from 3 to 10: just two platform giants are rising. A later 25% rally with the line reaching 20 is far more trustworthy.
example.zh: 指数涨25%，这条线只从3升到10，只有两家平台巨头在涨；后来同样涨25%而线升到20，那次就可信得多。

name.en: % of Golden Dragon China Stocks Above 200-Day MA
name.zh: 纳斯达克中国金龙指数成分股站上 200 日均线占比

formula.en: % = (ADRs with Close > SMA(Close, 200)) / about 65 × 100
formula.zh: 占比 = 收盘价高于200日均线的中概股数 / 约65 × 100

principle.en: The share of US-listed Chinese stocks above their 200-day line. They are priced mostly by one shared risk — how acceptable it is to own China ADRs — so they cross together.
principle.zh: 在美上市中概股站上200日均线的占比。它们主要由同一个风险定价——持有中概股是否“安全”——所以常常一起穿越均线。

example.en: A 30% rebound with the line moving only from 4 to 9 is two giants plus short covering. A similar rebound that lifts it from 4 to 52 has broadened and is more durable.
example.zh: 指数反弹30%而线只从4升到9，只是两只巨头加空头回补；同样反弹若让线从4升到52，说明已普遍扩散，更持久。

formula.en:
REMA = EMA(H − L, 10)
CVLT = (REMA − REMA 12 bars ago) / REMA 12 bars ago × 100
formula.zh:
REMA = EMA(最高 − 最低, 10)
CVLT =（REMA − 12根前的REMA）/ 12根前的REMA × 100

principle.en: Measures how fast the daily high-low range is widening or shrinking, not how volatile the market is. +60 means ranges are 60% wider than 12 bars ago.
principle.zh: 衡量每日高低价差扩大或收窄的速度，而不是波动率本身。+60表示振幅比12根K线前宽了60%。

example.en: A stock's average range sits near $0.90 for two months, then jumps to $1.40 and CVLT prints +55 as price breaks an eight-week high. The expansion confirms the breakout.
example.zh: 某股平均振幅两个月都在0.9美元左右，随后扩大到1.4美元、CVLT升至+55，同时价格突破八周高点，振幅放大确认了突破。

formula.en:
x = (C − C[2]) / RMS of that change over 50 bars
Soft = smooth(tanh(x)),  Hard = smooth(clip(x, −1, +1))
formula.zh:
x =（收盘 − 2根前收盘）/ 该变化50根的均方根
软线 = 平滑(tanh(x))，硬线 = 平滑(截断(x, −1, +1))

principle.en: Momentum measured in standard deviations, then squashed to ±1 in two ways: smoothly and by hard clipping. It stays comparable across calm and wild markets.
principle.zh: 用标准差衡量动量，再用平滑压缩和硬截断两种方式限制在±1之间，因此在平静和剧烈的市场里都能比较。

example.en: Bitcoin drops $2,000 in two bars during a volatile month. That is only −0.8σ here, so HSLC reads −0.35 and you correctly treat it as normal noise.
example.zh: 比特币在高波动月份两根K线跌2000美元，但这只相当于−0.8σ，HSLC读数−0.35，正确地把它当作正常波动。

formula.en:
Conversion = (HHV(H, 9) + LLV(L, 9)) / 2
Base = (HHV(H, 26) + LLV(L, 26)) / 2
Span A = (Conversion + Base) / 2, shifted 26 bars forward
Span B = (HHV(H, 52) + LLV(L, 52)) / 2, shifted 26 bars forward
Lagging = close shifted 26 bars back
formula.zh:
转换线 =（9周期最高 + 9周期最低）/ 2
基准线 =（26周期最高 + 26周期最低）/ 2
先行带A =（转换线 + 基准线）/ 2，向前平移26根
先行带B =（52周期最高 + 52周期最低）/ 2，向前平移26根
迟行线 = 收盘价向后平移26根

principle.en: A complete trend system built from midpoints of high-low ranges. The cloud between Span A and Span B is projected forward, so future support and resistance are already drawn today.
principle.zh: 一套完整的趋势系统，各条线都取高低价的中点。先行带A和B之间的“云”向前平移，今天就能看到未来的支撑和压力。

example.en: A stock breaks above a thick cloud at $52, runs to $63, then pulls back to the base line at $58.40 while the conversion line turns up. That first pullback is the classic entry.
example.zh: 某股在52美元突破厚云层，涨到63美元后回踩58.40美元的基准线，同时转换线拐头向上，这第一次回踩就是经典买点。

formula.en:
MI = C − C[1],  AMI = SMMA(MI, 3)
DIF = SMA(AMI[1], 10) − SMA(AMI[1], 20)
MICD = SMMA(DIF, 10)
formula.zh:
MI = 收盘 − 昨收，AMI = SMMA(MI, 3)
DIF = SMA(昨日AMI, 10) − SMA(昨日AMI, 20)
MICD = SMMA(DIF, 10)

principle.en: MACD rebuilt on daily price changes instead of price, with extra smoothing. It is very smooth but turns late, after most other indicators.
principle.zh: 把MACD改用每日涨跌额来计算，并多次平滑。线条非常平滑，但转向比其他指标都晚。

example.en: On a choppy stock MACD gave nine crossovers in a quarter, seven of them false. MICD gave only two, both on real moves, at the cost of entering later.
example.zh: 一只来回震荡的股票，一个季度里MACD交叉九次、七次是假信号；MICD只交叉两次且都对应真实行情，代价是入场更晚。

formula.en:
Up count: consecutive bars with C > C[4]
Down count: consecutive bars with C < C[4]
A run reaching 9 completes the setup; any break resets to 0
formula.zh:
上涨计数：连续满足 收盘 > 4根前收盘 的K线数
下跌计数：连续满足 收盘 < 4根前收盘 的K线数
计到9即完成，中途中断则归零

principle.en: Counts how many bars in a row closed above (or below) the close four bars earlier. Nine in a row suggests the move has run out of new buyers or sellers.
principle.zh: 数一数连续多少根K线收盘高于（或低于）4根之前的收盘。连续数到9，说明这波行情的新买家或卖家快用完了。

example.en: An index rallies 11% in three weeks; the count runs 1 to 9 and the ninth bar leaves a long upper wick at last year's high. A good moment to take profits.
example.zh: 指数三周涨11%，计数从1走到9，第9根K线在去年高点留下长上影线，是止盈的好时机。

formula.en:
RC = C / C[50]
ARC = SMMA(RC[1], 50)
formula.zh:
RC = 收盘 / 50根前收盘
ARC = SMMA(昨日RC, 50)

principle.en: Price divided by its price 50 bars ago, then heavily smoothed. It looks back about 100 bars, so it works only as a slow bull/bear regime line.
principle.zh: 当前价除以50根前的价格，再做重度平滑，实际回看约100根K线，只适合当作缓慢的牛熊分界线。

example.en: Only buy index constituents when the index's ARC is above 1.00. That filter would have kept you mostly out of the 2008 and 2022 declines.
example.zh: 规定只有指数的ARC高于1.00时才做多成分股。这个过滤条件能让你避开2008年和2022年的大部分下跌。

formula.en:
ARC = SMMA(C / C[59], 59)
DIF = SMA(ARC[1], 21) − SMA(ARC[1], 28)
RCCD = SMMA(DIF, 59)
formula.zh:
ARC = SMMA(收盘 / 59根前收盘, 59)
DIF = SMA(昨日ARC, 21) − SMA(昨日ARC, 28)
RCCD = SMMA(DIF, 59)

principle.en: A MACD built on the already slow RC line, with five layers of smoothing. It reacts extremely late and says almost nothing about today's market.
principle.zh: 在本就很慢的RC上再套一层MACD，共五层平滑。反应极其迟缓，几乎反映不了当下行情。

example.en: On monthly bars of a broad index, its zero line marks long secular shifts lasting years — like a tide chart, useless for today's waves.
example.zh: 在宽基指数的月线上，它的零轴能标出持续数年的长期转折，就像潮汐表——看不了今天的浪。

formula.en:
If C < C[9]: SRMI = (C − C[9]) / C[9]
If C > C[9]: SRMI = (C − C[9]) / C
Range: −1 to +1
formula.zh:
若 收盘 < 9根前收盘：SRMI =（收盘 − 9根前收盘）/ 9根前收盘
若 收盘 > 9根前收盘：SRMI =（收盘 − 9根前收盘）/ 收盘
取值范围：−1 至 +1

principle.en: A 9-bar rate of change that divides falls by the old price and rises by the new price. Equal round-trip moves up and down then look the same size.
principle.zh: 9根K线的变化率，下跌除以旧价、上涨除以新价，这样同等幅度的一涨一跌在图上大小一致。

example.en: A stock goes $8 to $16 and back to $8. Plain ROC shows +100 then −50; SRMI shows +0.5 then −0.5, matching that the moves cancel out.
example.zh: 某股从8美元涨到16美元再跌回8美元。普通ROC显示+100和−50，SRMI则显示+0.5和−0.5，正好对应两次波动相互抵消。

formula.en:
UP = WMA(V when C > EMA(C, 6), 14)
DN = WMA(V when C < EMA(C, 6), 14)
VSI = 100 × UP / (UP + DN)
formula.zh:
UP = WMA(收盘 > EMA(收盘, 6) 时的成交量, 14)
DN = WMA(收盘 < EMA(收盘, 6) 时的成交量, 14)
VSI = 100 × UP /（UP + DN）

principle.en: Like RSI, but built from volume: the share of recent volume traded on strong closes. It tells you whether a rise is backed by participation.
principle.zh: 类似RSI，但用成交量计算：最近成交量中有多少发生在强势收盘的K线上，用来判断上涨是否有人气支撑。

example.en: A stock breaks out of a six-week base on 40% more volume and VSI jumps from 48 to 82. The extra volume came on strong closes — real buying.
example.zh: 某股放量40%突破六周平台，VSI从48跳到82，新增成交量都出现在强势收盘日，说明是真实买盘。

name.zh: UT Bot 跟踪止损警报

formula.en:
Loss = K × ATR(10),  K = 1
Above the stop: stop = max(prior stop, C − Loss)
Below the stop: stop = min(prior stop, C + Loss)
Buy/sell when the close crosses the stop
formula.zh:
止损距离 = K × ATR(10)，K = 1
价格在线上：止损 = max(前止损, 收盘 − 止损距离)
价格在线下：止损 = min(前止损, 收盘 + 止损距离)
收盘穿越止损线时发出买卖信号

principle.en: An ATR trailing stop that only moves in your favour and flips sides when a close breaks it. It is best used as a mechanical exit.
principle.zh: 基于ATR的跟踪止损线，只朝有利方向移动，一旦收盘跌破就翻到另一侧。最适合当作机械化的离场规则。

example.en: Long at $40 with ATR $1.20, the stop starts at $38.80. Six weeks later price is $58 and the stop has climbed to $54.10, locking in most of the gain.
example.zh: 40美元买入、ATR为1.2美元，止损从38.80美元开始。六周后价格到58美元，止损已上移到54.10美元，锁住了大部分利润。

formula.en:
Up fractal: a high above the 2 bars on each side
Down fractal: a low below the 2 bars on each side
Confirmed only 2 bars after the pivot
formula.zh:
上分形：某根K线的最高价高于左右各2根
下分形：某根K线的最低价低于左右各2根
需等枢轴后2根K线才能确认

principle.en: An objective definition of a swing high or low: the extreme of a five-bar window. It turns a price chart into clear pivots for trendlines and stops.
principle.zh: 对波段高低点的客观定义：五根K线窗口里的最高或最低点。它把价格图变成清晰的转折点，方便画趋势线和设止损。

example.en: Long at $71, you set the stop just below the latest down fractal at $67.80, and raise it each time a higher down fractal forms.
example.zh: 71美元做多，把止损设在最近一个下分形67.80美元下方，每出现一个更高的下分形就上移止损。

formula.en: YoY growth = (Revenue this quarter − same quarter last year) / same quarter last year
formula.zh: 同比增长 =（本季营收 − 去年同季营收）/ 去年同季营收

principle.en: Everything the company sold in one quarter, before any costs. It is the fastest read on the business; compare it year over year to remove seasonality.
principle.zh: 公司一个季度卖出的全部金额，未扣任何成本，是最快反映生意好坏的数字。要做同比，才能去掉季节性影响。

example.en: A software firm's growth slows from 40% to 22% and the stock halves. Then a quarter prints 26% against 21% expected — the first re-acceleration, often the start of a big rally.
example.zh: 某软件公司增速从40%放缓到22%，股价腰斩；随后一个季度增速26%、高于预期的21%，首次重新加速，常是大涨的起点。

formula.en: Net Profit = Revenue − all costs, interest, tax and one-offs   (one quarter)
formula.zh: 净利润 = 营收 − 全部成本、利息、税费和一次性项目（单季）

principle.en: What is left for shareholders after every cost in one quarter. Fixed costs amplify it, so small sales changes cause big profit swings.
principle.zh: 一个季度扣除所有成本后留给股东的钱。固定成本会放大它，销售额小幅变化就会带来利润大幅波动。

example.en: A manufacturer near breakeven grows revenue 8% but net profit jumps 45%. Fixed costs are covered, so extra sales flow almost straight to profit.
example.zh: 一家接近盈亏平衡的制造商营收增长8%，净利润却跳升45%，因为固定成本已覆盖，新增销售几乎全部变成利润。

formula.en: FCF = Operating Cash Flow − Capital Expenditure
formula.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支

principle.en: The cash left each year after paying to maintain and grow the business. It is hard to fake and is what pays dividends, buybacks and debt reduction.
principle.zh: 每年扣除维持和扩张业务的投入后剩下的现金。它很难造假，分红、回购和还债都靠它。

example.en: A company grows FCF 12% a year and buys back 3% of its shares annually, so FCF per share grows about 15% — like a rental property whose rent rises every year.
example.zh: 某公司自由现金流每年增长12%，每年回购3%的股份，每股现金流就增长约15%，就像一套租金年年上涨的房子。

name.zh: 净资产收益率 · 年度

formula.en:
ROE = Net Income / Shareholders' Equity
ROE = Net Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier
formula.zh:
ROE = 净利润 / 股东权益
ROE = 净利率 × 资产周转率 × 权益乘数

principle.en: Profit earned per dollar of shareholder money. High and steady ROE signals a moat, but check whether it comes from margins or from debt.
principle.zh: 股东每投入一元能赚多少利润。长期高而稳定的ROE是护城河的标志，但要看它来自高利润率还是高负债。

example.en: Screen for ten straight years of ROE above 15% with low debt. The short list that remains is mostly businesses with real pricing power.
example.zh: 筛选连续十年ROE高于15%且负债不高的公司，剩下的短名单大多是真正有定价权的企业。

formula.en: Gross Margin = (Revenue − Cost of Goods Sold) / Revenue
formula.zh: 毛利率 =（营收 − 营业成本）/ 营收

principle.en: The share of each sales dollar left after the direct cost of the product. It is the clearest sign of pricing power; watch the trend over years.
principle.zh: 每一元销售额扣除产品直接成本后剩下的比例，是定价权最直接的体现，要看多年趋势。

example.en: Two rivals both grow sales 15%. One holds a 60% gross margin; the other slides from 55% to 48% — it is buying growth with price cuts.
example.zh: 两家竞争对手营收都增长15%，一家毛利率稳在60%，另一家从55%降到48%，后者是在靠降价换增长。

formula.en: Current Ratio = Current Assets / Current Liabilities
formula.zh: 流动比率 = 流动资产 / 流动负债

principle.en: Whether short-term assets like cash, receivables and inventory cover the bills due within a year. It is a safety check, not a measure of how good the business is.
principle.zh: 现金、应收款、存货等短期资产能否覆盖一年内到期的账单。它是安全检查，而不是衡量公司好坏的指标。

example.en: A ratio of 2 means $2 of short-term assets for every $1 due soon. Below 1, the company may need to borrow just to pay its bills.
example.zh: 比率为2表示每1元短期欠款有2元短期资产对应；低于1时，公司可能要借钱才能付账。

formula.en: Total Assets = Total Liabilities + Shareholders' Equity
formula.zh: 总资产 = 总负债 + 股东权益

principle.en: Everything the company owns at quarter-end. The size alone means little; it matters as the denominator in ROA and asset turnover.
principle.zh: 季末公司拥有的全部资产。规模本身意义不大，主要作为ROA和资产周转率的分母。

example.en: Total assets jump from $20bn to $28bn in one quarter. That usually means an acquisition or a big capital raise, not organic growth.
example.zh: 总资产一个季度从200亿美元跳到280亿美元，通常意味着一次收购或大额融资，而不是内生增长。

formula.en: Total Assets = Total Liabilities + Shareholders' Equity
formula.zh: 总资产 = 总负债 + 股东权益

principle.en: The year-end capital base a business stands on. Compare its growth with revenue and profit growth to see whether the company uses its capital efficiently.
principle.zh: 公司年末的资本底盘。把它的增长与营收、利润的增长对比，就能看出资本用得是否高效。

example.en: Over five years assets double but revenue grows only 30%. The company needs ever more capital per dollar of sales — like a shop that keeps expanding floor space without more customers.
example.zh: 五年里资产翻倍、营收只增30%，每赚一元销售要投入越来越多资本，就像店面越开越大却没多少新顾客。

formula.en: Equity = Total Assets − Total Liabilities
formula.zh: 股东权益 = 总资产 − 总负债

principle.en: What would be left for owners if every asset were sold at book value and every debt paid. It grows with retained profit and shrinks with losses, dividends and buybacks.
principle.zh: 如果资产按账面价卖掉、债务全部还清，股东还能剩下的部分。留存利润让它增加，亏损、分红和回购让它减少。

example.en: Equity drops from $10bn to $8bn in a quarter with no loss. A $2bn buyback is the likely cause, not a weakening business.
example.zh: 某季度股东权益从100亿美元降到80亿美元却没有亏损，很可能是进行了20亿美元的回购，而不是业务变差。

formula.en:
Equity = Total Assets − Total Liabilities
Book value per share = Equity / shares outstanding
formula.zh:
股东权益 = 总资产 − 总负债
每股净资产 = 股东权益 / 总股本

principle.en: The owners' book value at year-end, the base a long-term investment compounds on. Growth from retained profit, not new share issues, is what builds wealth.
principle.zh: 年末股东的账面净资产，是长期投资复利增长的基础。靠留存利润而非增发带来的增长，才真正创造财富。

example.en: A bank grows equity 10% a year from retained earnings and trades at 1× book. Like a savings account that pays 10%, its value tends to rise with it.
example.zh: 某银行靠留存利润每年让净资产增长10%，股价约为1倍市净率；就像年息10%的存款，股价往往随之上涨。

formula.en: Total Liabilities = Total Assets − Shareholders' Equity
formula.zh: 总负债 = 总资产 − 股东权益

principle.en: Everything the company owes at quarter-end: loans, bonds, supplier bills, wages, taxes. Compared with equity, it shows how much of the business runs on other people's money.
principle.zh: 季末公司欠下的全部款项：贷款、债券、应付货款、工资和税费。与股东权益对比，可看出公司多大程度靠别人的钱运转。

example.en: Liabilities jump $5bn in one quarter while equity is flat. A bond issue or debt-funded acquisition just made the company more fragile.
example.zh: 某季度负债猛增50亿美元而股东权益不变，说明刚发了债或举债收购，公司变得更脆弱。

formula.en:
Total Liabilities = Total Assets − Shareholders' Equity
Leverage = Total Liabilities / Equity
formula.zh:
总负债 = 总资产 − 股东权益
杠杆 = 总负债 / 股东权益

principle.en: The year-end total of all debts and obligations. High, rising leverage amplifies both good and bad years, because fixed obligations must be paid regardless.
principle.zh: 年末全部负债和义务的总额。杠杆高且上升会同时放大好年景和坏年景，因为固定债务无论如何都得偿还。

example.en: Two firms each earn $1bn; one owes 3× its equity, the other 0.5×. In a downturn the first may struggle to pay interest — like a family with a huge mortgage losing one income.
example.zh: 两家公司都赚10亿，一家负债是净资产的3倍，另一家只有0.5倍。逆境中前者可能付不起利息，就像房贷很重的家庭突然少了一份收入。

name.zh: 经营性现金流 · 单季

formula.en: OCF ≈ Net Profit + Depreciation ± Change in Working Capital
formula.zh: 经营现金流 ≈ 净利润 + 折旧摊销 ± 营运资本变动

principle.en: The cash the core business actually collected in a quarter. Comparing it with net profit shows whether reported earnings turned into real money or just IOUs.
principle.zh: 核心业务一个季度实际收到的现金。和净利润对比，能看出账面利润是变成了真金白银，还是只是一堆欠条。

example.en: A company reports $500m profit but only $50m operating cash flow, because receivables ballooned. Customers have not paid yet — a warning sign.
example.zh: 某公司报告净利润5亿美元，经营现金流却只有5000万，因为应收账款大增，客户还没付钱，这是警示信号。

name.zh: 经营性现金流 · 年度

formula.en:
OCF ≈ Net Income + Depreciation + non-cash charges ± Change in Working Capital
Cash conversion = OCF / Net Profit
formula.zh:
经营现金流 ≈ 净利润 + 折旧摊销 + 非现金费用 ± 营运资本变动
现金转化率 = 经营现金流 / 净利润

principle.en: Cash from the core business over a full year, with quarterly timing noise washed out. A quality business converts about $1 or more of cash per $1 of profit, year after year.
principle.zh: 全年核心业务产生的现金，消除了季度间的时间差。优质公司年复一年地每1元利润能换回1元以上现金。

example.en: Over five years a firm reports $10bn profit but only $6bn operating cash. Its business keeps eating cash, so the earnings deserve less trust.
example.zh: 某公司五年累计净利润100亿，经营现金流只有60亿，业务一直在吞噬现金，利润的可信度要打折扣。

formula.en:
FCF = Operating Cash Flow − Capital Expenditure
TTM FCF = sum of the last 4 quarters
formula.zh:
自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支
滚动12个月 = 最近4个季度之和

principle.en: The surplus cash in one quarter after running costs and investment. Capex and tax payments are lumpy, so read it as a rolling four-quarter sum.
principle.zh: 一个季度扣除经营和投资支出后剩下的现金。资本开支和税款支付不均匀，所以要看最近四个季度的滚动合计。

example.en: A healthy company shows −$200m FCF in the quarter it pays for a new factory. The trailing four-quarter total is still +$1.5bn, so there is no problem.
example.zh: 一家健康的公司在支付新工厂款项的那个季度自由现金流为−2亿美元，但最近四个季度合计仍有+15亿，并无问题。

name.zh: 稀释每股收益 · 单季

formula.en:
Diluted EPS = Net Income / fully diluted shares
Surprise % = (Actual − Consensus) / |Consensus|
formula.zh:
稀释每股收益 = 净利润 / 完全稀释后股数
超预期幅度 =（实际值 − 一致预期）/ |一致预期|

principle.en: One quarter's profit per share, counting options and convertibles that could become shares. It is the exact number the market compares with analyst forecasts on earnings day.
principle.zh: 单季利润除以股数，股数包括可能转成股票的期权和可转债。财报日市场就拿这个数和分析师预期对比。

example.en: Analysts expect $1.00 and the company reports $1.12, a 12% beat. The stock gaps up the next morning, priced straight off that number.
example.zh: 分析师预期1.00美元，公司公布1.12美元，超出12%，第二天早上股价直接高开。

name.zh: 稀释每股收益 · 年度

formula.en:
Diluted EPS = full-year Net Income / diluted weighted shares
Trailing P/E = Price / Diluted EPS
formula.zh:
稀释每股收益 = 全年净利润 / 稀释后加权股数
市盈率 = 股价 / 稀释每股收益

principle.en: A full year of profit per share — what one share actually earns. It is the base of the P/E ratio, and its long-term growth drives long-term returns.
principle.zh: 全年每股能分到的利润，也就是一股真正赚的钱。它是市盈率的基础，长期增长决定长期回报。

example.en: EPS grows from $2 to $4 over seven years, about 10% a year. At a steady P/E of 20, the share price roughly doubles from $40 to $80.
example.zh: 每股收益七年从2美元增到4美元，年均约10%。若市盈率稳定在20倍，股价大约从40美元翻倍到80美元。

formula.en: Gross Profit = Revenue − Cost of Goods Sold   (one quarter)
formula.zh: 毛利润 = 营收 − 营业成本（单季）

principle.en: Dollars left in a quarter after the direct cost of what was sold. It is just revenue times gross margin, so it adds little beyond those two.
principle.zh: 一个季度扣除产品直接成本后剩下的金额。它就是营收乘以毛利率，单独看信息不多。

example.en: Revenue $1bn at a 40% margin gives $400m gross profit. If it grows, check whether sales rose or the margin improved — that is the real story.
example.zh: 营收10亿、毛利率40%，毛利润就是4亿。如果它增长了，要看是销量增加还是毛利率提升，那才是关键。

formula.en: Gross Profit = Revenue − Cost of Goods Sold = Revenue × Gross Margin
formula.zh: 毛利润 = 营收 − 营业成本 = 营收 × 毛利率

principle.en: Full-year product-level profit before operating costs. It is smoother than the quarterly figure; its multi-year growth rate matters more than its size.
principle.zh: 全年扣除营业成本、但未扣经营费用的产品层面利润。比单季数据平滑，多年增速比绝对规模更重要。

example.en: Gross profit grows from $2bn to $3bn in three years, about 14% a year, while revenue grows 10%. Margin is expanding — a sign of pricing power.
example.zh: 毛利润三年从20亿增到30亿，年均约14%，而营收年增10%，说明毛利率在扩张，体现了定价权。

formula.en:
Net Profit = Revenue − all costs, interest, tax and one-offs   (full year)
P/E = Market Cap / Net Profit
formula.zh:
净利润 = 营收 − 全部成本、利息、税费和一次性项目（全年）
市盈率 = 总市值 / 净利润

principle.en: A full year's bottom line for shareholders. It is the E in P/E and the base of most valuations, but watch for large one-off charges distorting a single year.
principle.zh: 全年留给股东的最终利润，是市盈率中的“盈利”，也是大多数估值的基础；但要留意一次性大额费用扭曲某一年。

example.en: Profit falls from $2bn to $0.5bn because of a $1.5bn one-off write-down. Underlying earnings are flat, so the P/E spike is misleading.
example.zh: 净利润从20亿降到5亿，原因是一笔15亿的一次性减值。核心盈利其实没变，市盈率的飙升是误导。

formula.en:
Annual Revenue = Q1 + Q2 + Q3 + Q4
YoY growth = (This year − Last year) / Last year
formula.zh:
年度营收 = 一季度 + 二季度 + 三季度 + 四季度
同比增长 =（今年 − 去年）/ 去年

principle.en: Everything sold across a full year. Adding the four quarters cancels seasonality, so companies and years become directly comparable.
principle.zh: 全年的销售总额。四个季度相加抵消了季节性，不同公司和不同年份可以直接比较。

example.en: Revenue grows from $10bn to $13.3bn in three years, about 10% a year. That steady compounding is what price-to-sales valuations are based on.
example.zh: 营收三年从100亿增到133亿，年均约10%。这种稳定的复合增长正是市销率估值的依据。

formula.en: Net Profit to Parent = Net Profit − Minority Interests
formula.zh: 归母净利润 = 净利润 − 少数股东损益

principle.en: Quarterly profit that belongs to the parent company's own shareholders, after removing the share owned by outside holders of subsidiaries. This, not total profit, drives EPS.
principle.zh: 一个季度真正属于母公司股东的利润，扣除了子公司外部股东应得的部分。计算每股收益用的是它，而不是净利润总额。

example.en: A group owns 60% of a subsidiary earning $100m. All $100m appears in net profit, but only $60m reaches this line — your shares own only that part.
example.zh: 集团持有某子公司60%股权，子公司赚1亿。净利润里计入全部1亿，但归母净利润只有6000万，你的股份只拥有这部分。

formula.en:
Net Profit to Parent = Net Profit − Minority Interests   (full year)
EPS = Net Profit to Parent / shares
formula.zh:
归母净利润 = 净利润 − 少数股东损益（全年）
每股收益 = 归母净利润 / 股数

principle.en: Full-year profit belonging to the parent's shareholders. Trailing EPS and the P/E you pay are built on this line, with quarterly noise washed out.
principle.zh: 全年属于母公司股东的利润。滚动每股收益和你付出的市盈率都建立在这个数字上，季度噪音已被抹平。

example.en: Headline profit grows 20% but profit to parent grows only 5%. The growth came from partly owned subsidiaries, so your shares gained much less.
example.zh: 净利润增长20%，归母净利润却只增5%，增长主要来自非全资子公司，你的股份实际分到的少得多。

formula.en:
Operating Profit = Revenue − COGS − Operating Expenses
Operating Margin = Operating Profit / Revenue
formula.zh:
营业利润 = 营收 − 营业成本 − 经营费用
营业利润率 = 营业利润 / 营收

principle.en: Profit from running the core business in one quarter, before interest and tax. It shows how the operation itself performs, regardless of how it is funded.
principle.zh: 一个季度经营主业赚到的利润，未扣利息和税。它反映业务本身的表现，与公司如何融资无关。

example.en: Revenue rises 10% but operating profit rises 30% because rent and salaries stay fixed. That is operating leverage at work.
example.zh: 营收增长10%，营业利润却增长30%，因为房租和工资基本不变，这就是经营杠杆。

formula.en:
Operating Profit = Revenue − COGS − Operating Expenses   (full year, ≈ EBIT)
EV/EBIT = Enterprise Value / Operating Profit
formula.zh:
营业利润 = 营收 − 营业成本 − 经营费用（全年，约等于EBIT）
EV/EBIT = 企业价值 / 营业利润

principle.en: Full-year profit from core operations before interest and tax. Because it ignores debt and tax differences, it is the fairest way to compare very different companies.
principle.zh: 全年主营业务在利息和税前的利润。它不受负债和税务差异影响，是比较不同公司最公平的口径。

example.en: Two retailers each make $1bn operating profit; one has heavy debt, so its net profit is much lower. On EV/EBIT both are judged on the same footing.
example.zh: 两家零售商营业利润都是10亿，其中一家负债很重，净利润低得多。用EV/EBIT衡量，两者就站在同一起跑线上。

name.zh: 总资产收益率 · 单季

formula.en:
ROA = annualised quarterly Net Income / Total Assets
ROA = Net Margin × Asset Turnover
formula.zh:
ROA = 年化单季净利润 / 总资产
ROA = 净利率 × 资产周转率

principle.en: Profit earned per dollar of all assets, debt-funded or not. Unlike ROE it is not flattered by borrowing, so it shows how well the operation itself runs.
principle.zh: 每一元资产（无论是否借钱买的）能赚多少利润。它不像ROE那样会被借债抬高，更能看出经营本身的好坏。

example.en: A quarter earns $250m on $20bn of assets: annualised, ROA is 5%. Compare it with the same quarter last year, since single quarters are seasonal.
example.zh: 某季度用200亿资产赚了2.5亿，年化ROA为5%。单季有季节性，应与去年同季比较。

name.zh: 总资产收益率 · 年度

formula.en:
ROA = Net Income / Total Assets
ROE = ROA × Equity Multiplier
formula.zh:
ROA = 净利润 / 总资产
ROE = ROA × 权益乘数

principle.en: Full-year profit per dollar of assets, with financing removed. Comparing it with ROE shows how much of a high ROE is really just debt.
principle.zh: 全年每一元资产赚的利润，剔除了融资影响。把它和ROE对比，就知道高ROE里有多少只是靠负债撑起来的。

example.en: Two firms both show 20% ROE. One has 10% ROA, the other 2% — the second gets its ROE from 10× leverage, like a gambler on borrowed money.
example.zh: 两家公司ROE都是20%，一家ROA为10%，另一家只有2%。后者靠10倍杠杆撑出ROE，像借钱下注的赌徒。

name.zh: 净资产收益率 · 单季

formula.en:
ROE = annualised quarterly Net Income / Shareholders' Equity
ROE = Net Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier
formula.zh:
ROE = 年化单季净利润 / 股东权益
ROE = 净利率 × 资产周转率 × 权益乘数

principle.en: Return on shareholders' money measured from one quarter's profit. It is noisy, but it flags a change in ROE a couple of quarters before the annual figure.
principle.zh: 用单季利润计算的股东回报率。数据较嘈杂，但能比年报早一两个季度发现ROE的变化。

example.en: Quarterly ROE climbs from 12% to 16% year over year as margins widen. The annual ROE will likely follow, often before the market notices.
example.zh: 随着利润率提升，单季ROE同比从12%升到16%。年度ROE很可能随后跟上，而市场往往还没注意到。

name.zh: 投入资本回报率 · 年度

formula.en:
ROIC = NOPAT / Invested Capital
NOPAT = Operating Profit × (1 − tax rate)
Invested Capital = Debt + Equity − Cash
formula.zh:
ROIC = 税后经营利润 / 投入资本
税后经营利润 = 营业利润 ×（1 − 税率）
投入资本 = 有息负债 + 股东权益 − 现金

principle.en: After-tax operating profit on all the capital actually put to work, from lenders and owners alike. If ROIC beats the cost of capital, growth creates value; if not, it destroys it.
principle.zh: 所有实际投入的资本（无论来自债权人还是股东）的税后经营回报。ROIC高于资本成本，增长才创造价值，否则是在毁灭价值。

example.en: A company earns 20% ROIC while capital costs 8%. Every dollar it reinvests creates value — like borrowing at 8% to lend at 20%.
example.zh: 某公司ROIC为20%，资本成本只有8%，每再投入一元都在创造价值，就像以8%借钱再以20%放贷。

name.zh: 息税前利润率 · 年度

formula.en:
EBIT Margin = EBIT / Revenue
EBIT = Revenue − COGS − Operating Expenses
formula.zh:
息税前利润率 = 息税前利润 / 营收
息税前利润 = 营收 − 营业成本 − 经营费用

principle.en: The share of each sales dollar left as operating profit, before interest and tax. It sits between gross and net margin and measures the core business on its own terms.
principle.zh: 每一元销售额在扣除利息和税之前剩下的经营利润，介于毛利率和净利率之间，衡量主业自身的赚钱能力。

example.en: Revenue grows from $5bn to $6bn while EBIT margin widens from 15% to 18%. Fixed costs are spread over more sales — scale is paying off.
example.zh: 营收从50亿增至60亿，息税前利润率从15%升到18%，固定成本被更多销售摊薄，规模效应开始显现。

formula.en: Gross Margin = (Revenue − COGS) / Revenue   (one quarter)
formula.zh: 毛利率 =（营收 − 营业成本）/ 营收（单季）

principle.en: The share of one quarter's sales left after direct product costs. It is the first place a cost squeeze or a price cut shows up; compare it year over year.
principle.zh: 一个季度扣除产品直接成本后剩下的比例。原材料涨价或降价促销最先在这里体现，要做同比比较。

example.en: A coffee chain's gross margin drops from 58% to 53% when bean prices spike. Profit warnings usually follow a quarter later.
example.zh: 咖啡豆涨价后，某咖啡连锁的单季毛利率从58%降到53%，通常一个季度后就会出现利润预警。

formula.en:
BVPS = Shareholders' Equity / Shares Outstanding
P/B = Price / BVPS
formula.zh:
每股净资产 = 股东权益 / 总股本
市净率 = 股价 / 每股净资产

principle.en: The accounting net worth behind each share. It anchors the price-to-book ratio and matters most for asset-heavy businesses like banks and insurers.
principle.zh: 每股对应的账面净资产，是市净率的基础，对银行、保险这类重资产企业最有意义。

example.en: A bank has $50 book value per share and trades at $40, a P/B of 0.8. You are buying its net assets at 80 cents on the dollar.
example.zh: 某银行每股净资产50元，股价40元，市净率0.8，相当于用八折价格买下它的净资产。

formula.en: Effective Tax Rate = Income Tax Expense / Pre-tax Profit
formula.zh: 实际税率 = 所得税费用 / 税前利润

principle.en: The share of pre-tax profit actually paid in tax. Its main use is checking earnings quality: a profit beat built on an unusually low tax rate will not repeat.
principle.zh: 税前利润中实际交税的比例。主要用来检验盈利质量：靠异常低税率实现的利润超预期不可持续。

example.en: A company beats profit forecasts, but its tax rate fell from 25% to 12% thanks to a one-off credit. Operations did not improve; next year's profit will look worse.
example.zh: 某公司利润超预期，但税率因一次性抵免从25%降到12%，经营并没有改善，明年利润会显得更差。

formula.en: Current Ratio = Current Assets / Current Liabilities   (quarter-end)
formula.zh: 流动比率 = 流动资产 / 流动负债（季末）

principle.en: A quarter-end snapshot of whether short-term assets cover bills due within a year. It swings with the seasons, so the direction across quarters matters most.
principle.zh: 季末短期资产能否覆盖一年内到期账单的快照。它随季节波动，关键是看几个季度的变化方向。

example.en: The ratio slides from 1.8 to 1.5 to 1.2 to 0.9 over four quarters. Cash pressure is building well before the annual report shows it.
example.zh: 四个季度里流动比率从1.8降到1.5、1.2、0.9，资金压力在年报体现之前就已逐步积累。

formula.en: Quick Ratio = (Current Assets − Inventory) / Current Liabilities
formula.zh: 速动比率 =（流动资产 − 存货）/ 流动负债

principle.en: A stricter current ratio that leaves out inventory, which may be hard to sell in a downturn. It asks: can the company pay its bills without selling stock?
principle.zh: 更严格的流动比率，剔除了逆境中可能卖不掉的存货。它问的是：不卖存货，公司能付清账单吗？

example.en: A fashion retailer has a current ratio of 1.6 but a quick ratio of 0.5. Most of its liquidity is clothes on shelves that may need deep discounts.
example.zh: 某服装零售商流动比率1.6，速动比率却只有0.5，大部分流动性是货架上的衣服，可能要大幅打折才能变现。

formula.en: Quick Ratio = (Current Assets − Inventory) / Current Liabilities
formula.zh: 速动比率 =（流动资产 − 存货）/ 流动负债

principle.en: Year-end ability to pay near-term bills with cash, securities and receivables only. Around 1 means liquid assets just cover short-term debts.
principle.zh: 年末仅用现金、证券和应收款偿还短期账单的能力。约等于1表示速动资产刚好覆盖短期负债。

example.en: Like checking whether you could pay this month's bills from your bank account alone, without selling your car. A quick ratio of 1.2 means yes, with room to spare.
example.zh: 就像看看不卖车、只靠银行存款能否付清本月账单。速动比率1.2说明可以，而且还有余量。

name.zh: 固定资产周转率 · 单季

formula.en: Fixed Asset Turnover = Quarterly Revenue / Net Fixed Assets
formula.zh: 固定资产周转率 = 单季营收 / 固定资产净值

principle.en: Sales produced per dollar of plant and equipment in one quarter. It shows how hard factories and stores are being used, and swings with seasons and new capacity.
principle.zh: 一个季度每一元厂房设备带来的销售额，反映工厂和门店的利用程度，会随季节和新产能投产而波动。

example.en: A chipmaker opens a new fab and turnover drops from 0.5 to 0.35. The plant is not yet filled; it should recover as orders ramp up.
example.zh: 某芯片厂新工厂投产，周转率从0.5降到0.35，新产能尚未满载，随着订单增加应会回升。

name.zh: 固定资产周转率 · 年度

formula.en: Fixed Asset Turnover = Annual Revenue / Net Fixed Assets
formula.zh: 固定资产周转率 = 全年营收 / 固定资产净值

principle.en: Sales per dollar of plant and equipment over a full year. It reveals how capital-intensive a business is and whether its assets are used efficiently versus peers.
principle.zh: 全年每一元厂房设备带来的销售额，反映业务的资本密集程度，以及资产利用效率是否优于同行。

example.en: A software firm turns over its fixed assets 10× a year; a steelmaker manages 1×. The steelmaker needs far more capital for each dollar of sales.
example.zh: 一家软件公司固定资产周转率每年10次，钢铁厂只有1次，钢铁厂每赚一元销售需要多得多的资本。

formula.en:
Inventory Turnover = Quarterly COGS / Average Inventory
Days of inventory ≈ 91 / turnover
formula.zh:
存货周转率 = 单季营业成本 / 平均存货
存货周转天数 ≈ 91 / 周转率

principle.en: How many times stock is sold and replaced in a quarter. Slowing turnover means goods are piling up, which usually forces discounts a quarter or two later.
principle.zh: 一个季度存货卖出并补充的次数。周转变慢说明货物在积压，通常一两个季度后就得打折清货。

example.en: A retailer's turnover falls from 1.5 to 1.1 versus last year: stock now sits about 83 days instead of 61. Markdowns are likely next quarter.
example.zh: 某零售商周转率同比从1.5降到1.1，存货天数从约61天拉长到83天，下季度很可能要降价促销。

formula.en:
Inventory Turnover = Annual COGS / Average Inventory
Days of inventory = 365 / turnover
formula.zh:
存货周转率 = 全年营业成本 / 平均存货
存货周转天数 = 365 / 周转率

principle.en: How many times a year the company cycles through its entire inventory. Higher means leaner operations and less cash tied up in stock; compare within an industry.
principle.zh: 公司一年内把全部存货周转几次。越高说明运营越精简、占用现金越少，要在同行业内比较。

example.en: A grocer turns inventory 12 times a year (about 30 days); a furniture maker 4 times (about 90 days). Like a fruit stand versus an antique shop.
example.zh: 超市每年周转12次（约30天），家具商只有4次（约90天），就像水果摊和古董店的区别。

name.zh: 应付账款周转率 · 单季

formula.en:
Payables Turnover = Quarterly COGS / Average Accounts Payable
Days payable ≈ 91 / turnover
formula.zh:
应付账款周转率 = 单季营业成本 / 平均应付账款
应付天数 ≈ 91 / 周转率

principle.en: How quickly the company pays its suppliers. Paying slower keeps cash longer: smart if the company has bargaining power, a warning sign if it is short of cash.
principle.zh: 公司向供应商付款的速度。付得越慢，现金留得越久：有议价能力时是精明，缺钱时则是危险信号。

example.en: Days payable jump from 45 to 75 in one quarter while sales fall. Suppliers are being made to wait — likely a cash squeeze, not bargaining power.
example.zh: 销售下滑的同时，应付天数一个季度从45天拉长到75天，供应商被迫等待，更可能是现金紧张而非议价能力强。

name.zh: 应付账款周转率 · 年度

formula.en:
Payables Turnover = Annual COGS / Average Accounts Payable
Days payable = 365 / turnover
Cash cycle = Days inventory + Days receivable − Days payable
formula.zh:
应付账款周转率 = 全年营业成本 / 平均应付账款
应付天数 = 365 / 周转率
现金周期 = 存货天数 + 应收天数 − 应付天数

principle.en: How many times a year the company pays off its suppliers. Days payable is one leg of the cash cycle: the longer you can wait to pay, the less cash you need.
principle.zh: 公司一年内结清应付账款的次数。应付天数是现金周期的一环：付款能拖得越久，需要的营运资金越少。

example.en: A big retailer sells goods in 30 days but pays suppliers in 60. Suppliers effectively fund its inventory — a negative cash cycle.
example.zh: 某大型零售商30天就卖掉货物，却60天才付款给供应商，相当于供应商在替它垫资，现金周期为负。

name.zh: 应收账款周转率 · 单季

formula.en:
Receivables Turnover = Quarterly Revenue / Average Accounts Receivable
Days sales outstanding ≈ 91 / turnover
formula.zh:
应收账款周转率 = 单季营收 / 平均应收账款
应收天数 ≈ 91 / 周转率

principle.en: How fast credit sales turn into cash in a quarter. If sales hold up but collection slows, customers may be struggling or revenue may be booked too aggressively.
principle.zh: 一个季度赊销变成现金的速度。如果销售没降但回款变慢，可能是客户出了问题，也可能是收入确认过于激进。

example.en: Revenue grows 15% but days to get paid jump from 40 to 65. Sales are being booked faster than cash arrives — a red flag.
example.zh: 营收增长15%，回款天数却从40天跳到65天，收入入账比现金到账快得多，这是危险信号。

name.zh: 应收账款周转率 · 年度

formula.en:
Receivables Turnover = Annual Revenue / Average Accounts Receivable
Days sales outstanding = 365 / turnover
formula.zh:
应收账款周转率 = 全年营收 / 平均应收账款
应收天数 = 365 / 周转率

principle.en: How many times a year the company collects what customers owe. A steady multi-year decline is a serious warning about customer quality or accounting.
principle.zh: 公司一年内收回客户欠款的次数。连续多年下降，是客户质量或会计处理出问题的严重警告。

example.en: Turnover falls from 8 to 5 over three years: customers now take 73 days to pay instead of 46. Growth is increasingly on credit.
example.zh: 三年里周转率从8降到5，客户付款时间从46天拉长到73天，增长越来越依赖赊销。

name.zh: 总资产周转率 · 年度

formula.en:
Asset Turnover = Annual Revenue / Average Total Assets
ROE = Net Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier
formula.zh:
总资产周转率 = 全年营收 / 平均总资产
ROE = 净利率 × 资产周转率 × 权益乘数

principle.en: Revenue generated per dollar of everything the company owns. It is the efficiency part of ROE and shows whether a firm wins on margin or on volume.
principle.zh: 公司每一元总资产带来的营收，是ROE中的“效率”部分，能看出公司靠高利润率还是靠高周转赚钱。

example.en: A discount store turns assets 2.5× at a 3% margin; a luxury brand 0.6× at a 20% margin. Both can earn good returns — one by volume, one by price.
example.zh: 折扣超市资产周转2.5次、净利率3%；奢侈品牌周转0.6次、净利率20%。两者都能赚钱，一个靠量，一个靠价。
